items.name: Alchemist's Beaker
items.description: A glass beaker containing a liquid with 1d4+1 different layers. Each layer has the effects of a magic potion.

properties.value: The referee randomly selects the 1d4+1 potion types. (Duplicates and detrimental potions are possible.)
Potions are always poured out in the order of the layers.
Is dangerous. See Mixing Potions, p196 .
Once all layers have been poured out, the liquid replenishes after a number of days equal to the number of potions in the beaker.
Every month, the beaker stops being able to produce the lowest layer of the liquid, eventually losing its magical power altogether.

items.name: Amulet of Protection Against Possession
items.description: An amulet that prevents disembodied spirits from entering and possessing the wearer's body.

properties.value: The magic-user spell magic jar cannot affect the wearer. (See Magic-User Spells in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome .)
The possession attack of a ghost is ineffective against the wearer. (See p57 .)

items.name: Amulet of Protection Against Scrying
items.description: An amulet that provides protection from remote viewing and mind-reading.

properties.value: The person wearing this amulet cannot be viewed in a crystal ball.
The wearer is immune to all forms of ESP.

items.name: Apparatus of the Crab
items.description: A large (6' tall, 4' around) iron barrel which acts as a mechanical aquatic vehicle. Appears like a giant crab when in use.

properties.value: A secret entry hatch in one side allows entry to the apparatus.
Inside the apparatus are a series of levers with the following effects:
With legs and tail extended, the apparatus can move at a rate of 60' (20') on land or in water.
b.  Uncover/cover forward porthole
c.  Uncover/cover side portholes
When extended, the apparatus can attack.
Two attacks per round, THAC0 19 [0], 2d6 damage.
f.  Move forward/backward
g.  Turn left/right
h.  Rise/sink in water
Project light in a 30' radius around the apparatus.
When closed, the apparatus is watertight.
The apparatus is treated as a vehicle (see Vehicles in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ) with AC 0 [19] and 40 hull points.
Up to 2 human-sized people can fit inside the apparatus.
Once sealed, there is air sufficient for 1d4+1 hours (twice that if only a single person is inside).

items.name: Arrow of Location
items.description: A normal-looking arrow with the power to point the way to certain dungeon features.

properties.value: The arrow must be thrown into the air and the type of feature to be located stated out loud. The arrow falls onto the ground pointing in the direction of the nearest feature of the named type.
Dungeon entrance/ exit, stairway up, stairway down.

The direction to a dungeon feature may be requested only once per day. Once the nearest feature has been indicated, the arrow may be thrown up to 7 additional times (at 1 turn intervals) and will indicate the direction to the previously located feature.

items.name: Bag of Devouring
items.description: A normal-looking, small sack that devours objects placed inside it.

properties.value: Anything placed inside the bag vanishes from existence after 1d6+6 turns.
May be affected, but only if the entire creature fits inside the bag.

items.name: Bag of Holding
items.description: A normal-looking small sack that can magically hold large objects and weights.

properties.value: Objects of up to 10'×5'×3' can fit inside the bag.
Up to 10,000 coins of weight can be placed in the bag.
The bag weighs 600 coins.

items.name: Bag of Transformation
items.description: A normal-looking small sack that can magically hold large objects and weights. Its magic is unstable and after some time will transmute objects placed inside.

properties.value: Objects of up to 10'×5'×3' can fit inside the bag.
Up to 10,000 coins of weight can be placed in the bag.
The bag weighs 600 coins.
After 1d6 days of use, the bag becomes cursed.
When the curse is active, precious items in the bag are transmuted into worthless items (e.g. precious metals into lead, gems into rocks, magic items into normal items, etc.).

items.name: Book of Foul Corruption
items.description: An unremarkable book with a powerful, unholy enchantment. Opening the book produces an effect dependent on the class and alignment of the character.

properties.value: Must save versus death or die.
Change alignment to chaotic.

Sense the book's foulness and may study it (requires 1 week) to gain one experience level and one point of WIS. A character can only gain this benefit once, even if another book of foul corruption is discovered.
Must save versus spells or lose 1 point of INT.
Suffer 4d10 damage.
Change alignment to chaotic.
Unaffected.
Once the book's magical effect has occurred, it vanishes.

items.name: Book of Infinite Spells
items.description: A tome of great magical power with 1d8 + 12 pages. Each page grants the owner the ability to cast a spell.

properties.value: Suffer 5d4 damage and are paralysed for 5d4 turns upon first opening the book. Thereafter, they may benefit as normal from its powers.
The owner gains the ability to cast the associated spell. Spells are of level 1-5 and may be of any type (e.g. cleric, druid, magic-user). Level and type are determined randomly per page.
The spell on the previous page disappears forever and the owner loses the ability to cast it. Once all pages have been read, the book is empty.
The owner may cast the spell on the last page read once per day. If the spell is one that the character could normally cast (according to class and level), they can cast it 4 times a day.

properties.key: Each time a spell is cast
properties.value: There is a 1-in-6 chance of the spell disappearing from its page in the book. The owner loses the ability to cast the spell and must turn to another page.
The owner benefits from the book's power even if it is not on their person. It may thus be stored.

items.name: Book of Sublime Holiness
items.description: An unremarkable book with a powerful, holy enchantment. The effects of opening the book depend on the class and alignment of the character.

properties.value: Sense that the book is holy and may study it (requires 1 week) to gain one experience level and one point of WIS. A character can only gain this benefit once, even if another book of sublime holiness is discovered.

Lose one experience level. This incurs a loss of one Hit Die of hit points, as well as all other benefits due to the lost level (e.g. spells, saving throws, etc.). The character's XP is reduced to halfway between the former and new levels. If this would reduce the character below 1st level, they are either unaffected (neutral alignment) or die (chaotic).
Must save versus spells or lose 1 point of INT.
Unaffected.
Suffer 4d10 damage.
Once the book's magical effect has occurred, it vanishes.

items.name: Boots of Dancing
items.description: Cursed boots which cause the wearer to dance uncontrollably.

properties.value: The curse takes effect when the character is in melee or evading an encounter.
Cannot attack or move, -4 penalty to AC, -4 penalty to all saving throws.
Once the curse is active, the character cannot remove the boots. The curse can only be removed with magic (e.g. remove curse ).

items.name: Boots of Levitation
items.description: The wearer is able to move up and down through the air at will.

properties.value: The caster mentally directs vertical movement at up to 20' per round.
The caster can push against solid objects to move laterally.
A normal amount of weight can be carried while levitating.
The enchantment may be used without limit of frequency or duration.

items.name: Boots of Speed
items.description: The wearer is able to move at up to 240' (80')-the speed of a riding horse.

properties.value: This can be maintained for up to 12 hours.
Afterwards, the wearer must rest for 1 day.

items.name: Boots of Travelling and Leaping
items.description: The wearer is able to travel without tiring and leap great distances.

properties.value: The normal need for rest when travelling may be ignored (see Wilderness Adventuring in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ).
The wearer can leap up to 10' high and 30' horizontally.

items.name: Bracers of Armour
items.description: Enchanted wrist-guards which grant the wearer protection as if wearing armour.

properties.value: The bracers grant an AC of 8 - 1d4 [11 + 1d4]. (The AC granted by each pair of bracers is fixed.)
The bracers grant no benefit.

items.name: Bracers of Defencelessness
items.description: Cursed wrist-guards which seem to grant the wearer protection as if they were wearing armour, but actually render them defenceless.

properties.value: The bracers grant an AC of 5 [14], as long as the character wears no armour.
Once the wearer is in a dangerous combat situation, the bracers' curse activates.
Once the curse is activated, the wearer's AC is 9 [10]. Any bonuses due to DEX or other magical protections are negated.
Once the curse is active, the character cannot remove the bracers. The curse can only be removed by magic (e.g. remove curse ).

items.name: Brooch of Shielding
items.description: A clasp of silver or gold (usually without jewels) which protects the wearer from magic missiles (from spells, wands, etc.).

properties.value: Magic missiles target and hit the character normally, but the brooch absorbs the damage inflicted.
Once the brooch has negated 101 hit points of damage from magic missiles , its power is spent.
The brooch dissolves, becoming utterly useless.

items.name: Broom of Flying
items.description: A broom that can be commanded to fly, carrying the owner aloft.

properties.value: The broom flies at 240' (80').
An additional passenger may be carried. When carrying two people, the broom's speed is 180' (60').

items.name: Candle of Invocation
items.description: Specially consecrated candles associated with a specific alignment (determined randomly). Characters of that alignment gain benefits when lighting the candle.

properties.key: If lit by a divine caster
properties.value: The character is able to memorize and cast spells as if they were two experience levels higher, as long as the candle burns. When the candle goes out, any memorized spells beyond those the character may normally have are lost.
The character gains a +1 bonus to attack rolls and saving throws, as long as the candle burns.
The candle burns for a total of 4 hours. It can be extinguished and relit.

items.name: Chime of Opening
items.description: A 1' long, hollow metal tube which has the power to open bonds, locks, portals, etc. when sounded.

properties.value: Each time the chime is sounded and left to ring for one minute, one portal, lock, lid, bar, etc. (as selected by the user), is caused to open.
There is a 1-in-6 chance of wandering monsters being attracted each time the chime is sounded.
Hold portal and wizard lock spells are negated (the latter only if cast by a character below 9th level).
After being sounded 4d20 times, the chime shatters.

items.name: Chime of Ravening
items.description: A 1' long, hollow metal tube which brings about maddening hunger when sounded.

properties.value: All within 60' .
Will drop anything in their hands and immediately consume the available food for 1d6 rounds.
Will move as fast as possible to the location where the chime was sounded. Once there, they will attempt to kill and eat anyone present.
Each round a creature eats, it may save versus spells to end the ravenous hunger.

items.name: Cloak of Defence
items.description: A cloak of any possible appearance or material which magically protects the wearer from harm.

properties.value: The wearer gains a bonus to AC and all saving throws.
When the cloak is found, roll 1d8: 1-4: +1, 5-6: +2, 7-8: +3.
If the character uses a shield, wears armour heavier than leather, or wears magical armour, the cloak has no effect.

items.name: Cloak of Flight
items.description: A plain-looking black cloak which can grant the power of flight to the wearer.

properties.value: Upon speaking the correct command word, the cloak transforms into a pair of great bat wings (20' wingspan), allowing the wearer to fly for a limited period.
360' (120') for up to 2 turns, 180' (60') for up to 4 turns, or 120' (40') for up to 8 turns.
The character can fly with up to their normal maximum load.

Following a flight of the maximum number of turns listed above, the character must lay down and rest for 6 turns. Shorter flights require the character to rest proportionally less (e.g. a flight at the fastest rate for 1 turn requires 3 turns of rest).
Up to once per day.

items.name: Cloak of Poison
items.description: A woollen cloak which instantly slays anyone who dons it.

properties.value: The cloak can be handled safely.
As long as the cloak remains in place, the victim cannot be restored to life.
Once donned, can only be removed by magic (e.g. remove curse ). The victim may then be revived by other magic (first to neutralize the poison and then to restore life).

items.name: Cloak of the Manta Ray
items.description: A leather cloak which wraps around the wearer when submerged in salt water, granting them abilities like those of a manta ray.

properties.value: The wearer can breathe underwater.
The wearer can swim at 180' (60') with ray-like wings.
The wearer's AC is 6 [13], unless improved by magical armour or protective devices.
The wearer can attack once a round with a tail barb (for 1d6 damage) and may also free their arms from the cloak to make other attacks.
While wearing the cloak underwater, the wearer is 90% indistinguishable from a real manta ray.

items.name: Crystal Ball
items.description: Allows an arcane spell caster to view any place or object that is brought to mind:

properties.value: The vision lasts for one turn.
The clarity of the vision is dependant on the scryer's familiarity with the subject.
A crystal ball may be used at most 3 times a day.
It is not possible to cast spells through a crystal ball into the viewed scene.

items.name: Crystal Ball With Clairaudience
items.description: The scryer can hear, as well as see, the desired scene.

items.name: Crystal Ball With ESP
items.description: Allows the scryer to spy on the thoughts of creatures viewed in the crystal ball:

properties.value: The thoughts of a single creature viewed through the crystal ball may be read.
The scryer understands the meaning of all thoughts even if they do not share the creature's language.
The ability to perceive thoughts is obstructed by a thin layer of lead or by rock of 2' thick or greater.

items.name: Crystal Hypnosis Ball
items.description: Grants an arcane spell caster false visions of any place or object that is brought to mind, while in reality bringing the user under the sway of a baleful intelligence.

properties.value: The user sees the desired place or object in the crystal ball for up to 1 turn, but all impressions are false.
Grants visions at most 3 times a day.
In reality, the user comes into mental contact with the creator of the crystal ball-a malignant magic-user, lich, extra-planar entity, etc. The visions are fabricated by that being.

Following each use of the crystal ball, a suggestion is telepathically implanted in the mind of the user. These suggestions cause the user to gradually come under the influence of the remote intelligence, eventually coming to do its bidding.

items.name: Cube of Force
items.description: A ¾ inch cube of bone, ivory, or stone. Pressing the faces of the cube activates a 10' cubic force field around the character.

properties.value: Each face of the cube activates or deactivates the force field, with the effects shown in the table below.
The cube has 36 charges per day. Activating the force field consumes a number of charges per turn (see table).

Effects other than those listed in the table can be blocked, but cost additional charges: catapult shot / thrown boulders: 1 charge; wall of fire / non-magical inferno: 2; fire ball / pass-wall : 3; lightning bolt : 4; horn of blasting / disintegrate : 6.

items.name: Cube of Force: Effects by Side
items.description: Charges: Charges expended per turn. Move: Maximum movement rate while force field of this type is active.

items.name: Cube of Frost Resistance
items.description: A ¾ inch cube of bone, ivory, or stone. Pressing a face activates a 10' cubic field of protection around the character.

properties.value: A pleasant ambient temperature is maintained even if external conditions are much colder.
Are absorbed by the field. If more than 50 hit points of damage are absorbed in the space of 1 turn, the field collapses and cannot be reactivated for 1 hour.

items.name: Decanter of Endless Water
items.description: A stoppered flask which, upon speaking the proper command word, pours forth fresh or salt water at three different rates of flow.

properties.value: A trickle of 1 gallon (8 pints) per round.
A 5' high fountain of 5 gallons per round.
A 20' long jet of 30 gallons per round. Anyone holding the decanter must make a STR check each round or be knocked down by the force of the geyser.
The geyser can be used as a missile attack (20' range), inflicting 1d2 damage per hit.
The geyser will fill a 10' cubic space every 4 turns.
A command word stops the water flowing, allowing the stopper to be put back in.

items.name: Deck of Many Things
items.description: A deck of 22 ivory or vellum cards stored in a box or leather pouch. Each card is inscribed with an image and a set of magical glyphs.

properties.value: The deck of many things may be simulated with 22 normal playing cards (indicated alongside the name of each card, below).
A character may elect to draw up to 4 cards from the deck, being affected by the magical effects of each card (see below). Drawn cards magically return to the deck.
Each character may only draw once (1-4 cards) from a deck of many things.

items.name: Sun (King of Diamonds)
items.description: Gain 50,000 XP and one beneficial miscellaneous magic item. (Roll for the magic item until something beneficial to the character comes up.)

items.name: Moon (Queen of Diamonds)
items.description: 1d4 wishes, which must be used within 1 turn per wish received.

items.name: Star (Jack of Diamonds)
items.description: Prime requisite increases by 2 points. If this would raise the score above 18, the points are instead allocated to random ability scores.

items.name: Vizier (Ace of Diamonds)
items.description: Grants the true and thorough answer to one question or problem. The question may be posed immediately or at any time in the future.

items.name: Comet (2 of Diamonds)
items.description: Single-handedly defeat the next hostile monster(s) encountered to gain a level.

items.name: Throne (King of Hearts)
items.description: CHA increases to 18 and the character gains possession of a small keep.

items.name: Key (Queen of Hearts)
items.description: Gain a random treasure map plus a random magic weapon, staff, or wand (as appropriate to the character).

items.name: Knight (Jack of Hearts)
items.description: Gain the loyal service of a 4th level fighter.

items.name: Fates (Ace of Hearts)
items.description: Allows the character to avoid one situation or the effects of one event, usable at any point in the future. The character's companions do not gain the same benefit.

items.name: Gem (2 of Hearts)
items.description: Gain 20 random gems or 20 random pieces of jewellery.

items.name: The Void (King of Clubs)
items.description: The character becomes a mindless automaton, their soul trapped in a prison on another world or plane of existence. The soul can only be retrieved by questing (even a wish cannot retrieve it). When this card is drawn, the deck of many things disappears -no further cards can be drawn.

items.name: Flames (Queen of Clubs)
items.description: A powerful chaotic monster from another plane of existence becomes aware of the character and schemes to destroy them.

items.name: Skull (Jack of Clubs)
items.description: A lesser grim reaper appears and attacks the character, who must defeat it alone. If the character is slain, they can never be returned to life. If other characters help in the battle, lesser grim reapers appear to fight them as well. Lesser Grim Reaper: AC -3 [22], HD 10** (45hp), Att 1 × scythe (2d8), THAC0 11 [+8], MV 120' (40'), SV D6 W7 P8 B8 S10 (10), ML 12, AL Neutral, XP 2,300

properties.value: Immune to effects that affect living creatures (e.g. poison). Immune to mind-affecting or mind-reading spells (e.g. charm , hold , sleep ).
Always wins.
Always hits.
Unharmed by cold, fire, and electricity.

items.name: Idiot (Ace of Clubs)
items.description: Lose 1d4 points of INT. The character may choose to draw another card.

items.name: Talons (2 of Clubs)
items.description: All magic items owned by the character vanish instantly and permanently.

items.name: Ruin (King of Spades)
items.description: All money, valuables, and property owned by the character vanish instantly and permanently.

items.name: Medusa (Queen of Spades)
items.description: Suffer a permanent -3 penalty to saves vs petrification.

items.name: Rogue (Jack of Spades)
items.description: A friendly NPC (a retainer, if the character has any) becomes utterly and permanently hostile toward the character. The hatred is initially secret and will only be revealed at a devastating moment.

items.name: Donjon (Ace of Spades)
items.description: The character is stripped of all equipment and spells and is imprisoned, either magically or physically. When this card is drawn, the deck of many things disappears-no further cards can be drawn.

items.name: Balance (2 of Spades)
items.description: Change alignment (lawful becomes chaotic, chaotic becomes lawful, neutral becomes lawful or chaotic). If the character fails to behave according to their new alignment, they will be judged by higher powers and risk annihilation.

items.name: Jester (Jester without Trademark)
items.description: Gain 10,000 XP or draw two more cards. After being drawn, the Jester card disappears forever.

items.name: Fool (Jester with Trademark)
items.description: Lose 10,000 XP (to a minimum of 0 XP) and draw another card. After being drawn, the Fool card disappears forever.

items.name: Displacer Cloak
items.description: A cloak that bends light, making one who wears it appear to be 5' away from their true location.

properties.value: The wearer gains a +2 bonus to saving throws against petrification, rods, spells, staves, and wands.
Against the wearer are penalised by -2.

items.name: Drums of Panic
items.description: Large war drums that induce panic in those who hear their sound.

properties.value: Creatures up to 240' away, are affected, when the drums are played. Those within 10' of the drums are not affected.

Are afflicted by the drums' enchantment of fear: they must save versus spells or make a morale check with a -2 penalty (if the optional morale rules are being used-see Morale in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ).
Creatures that fail the saving throw or morale check flee from the sound of the drums at full running speed for 30 rounds.

items.name: Drums of Thunder
items.description: A pair of kettle drums which, when both struck together, unleash a deafening thunder.

properties.value: Are permanently deafened by the noise. The deafness can only be cured by powerful magic (e.g. cure serious wounds cast expressly for the purpose).
Are also stunned and unable to move or act for 2d4 rounds.

items.name: Dust of Appearance
items.description: Silk-wrapped parcels of ultra-fine, metallic dust which can reveal invisible things. Usually 5d10 parcels are found together.

properties.value: The dust coats everything in a 10' radius.
The dust coats everything in a 20' long cone, 15' wide at the end.
Anything coated in the dust is rendered visible for 2d10 turns, negating magic of invisibility, camouflage, displacement, and mirror imaging.

items.name: Dust of Disappearance
items.description: Silk-wrapped parcels of ultra-fine, metallic dust which renders anything it touches invisible. Usually 5d10 parcels are found together.

properties.value: The dust coats everything in a 10' radius.
The dust coats everything in a 20' long cone, 15' wide at the end.
Anything coated in the dust is rendered invisible for 2d10 turns.
Always surprise others and gain a +4 bonus to AC. (These benefits do not apply with enemies who can detect invisible.)

items.name: Dust of Sneezing and Choking
items.description: Silk-wrapped parcels of ultra-fine, metallic dust which acts as a deadly poison when cast into the air. Usually 5d10 parcels are found together.

properties.value: The dust fills a 20' radius.
The dust fills a 20' long cone, 15' wide at the end.
Any creatures in the area of the dust are overcome with fits of coughing and sneezing and must save versus poison or die. Those that make the save are unable to act or move for 5d4 rounds.

items.name: Efreeti Bottle
items.description: A 3' tall, weighty jug with a sealed stopper. Breaking the seal and removing the stopper releases a trapped lesser efreeti (see p49 ), who will serve the character.

properties.value: The efreeti will serve the one who freed it (and only that character) once per day.
After 101 days, its service ends. The creature then returns to its home-the legendary City of Brass.
Its service ends.

items.name: Elemental Summoning Device
items.description: Ritual items enchanted with the power to summon beings from the elemental planes. Each elemental plane has a different type of device:

properties.value: A censer.
A 6' diameter stone.
A brazier.
A 3' diameter bowl. Usage: The items may be used as follows:
The summoning power may only be used once per day.
The device must be prepared. This takes one turn.
Once prepared, activating the device takes one round.
A 12 HD elemental (see p50 ) is conjured to do the summoner's bidding.
Works as described in the magic-user spell conjure elemental (see Magic-User Spells in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ).

items.name: Elven Cloak and Boots
items.description: A set of enchanted boots and a matching cloak, of elven origin.

properties.value: The wearer of the boots is able to move silently.
The wearer of the cloak is rendered almost invisible: there is only a 1-in-6 chance of them being spotted.
The cloak's power of invisibility is nullified for one turn, if the wearer attacks.

items.name: Eyes of Charming
items.description: A pair of crystal lenses that fit over the eyes. The wearer gains the power to charm persons who meet their gaze.

properties.value: A charm may be placed upon a person within 60' . One target may be charmed per round.
The subject may save versus spells to resist, with a +2 bonus if only one of the lenses is worn.

Regard the character as a trusted friend, and will come to their defence. Subjects will obey the character's commands, as long as these are not obviously harmful and do not contradict the subject's alignment.
The charm lasts until dispelled or until the eyes are removed.

items.name: Eyes of Minuscule Sight
items.description: A pair of crystal lenses that fit over the eyes, granting the ability to see minuscule details at close range (1' or less).

properties.value: Causes intense dizziness, unless the other eye is closed.

items.name: Eyes of Petrification
items.description: A pair of crystal lenses that fit over the eyes. The wearer is instantly turned to stone, without a saving throw.

items.name: Eyes of the Eagle
items.description: A pair of crystal lenses that fit over the eyes, enhancing long range vision by 100 times (e.g. the wearer can see details at a distance of 2,000' that would normally be visible at 20').

properties.value: Causes intense dizziness, unless the other eye is closed.

items.name: Feather Token
items.description: A small feather which produces a magical effect when thrown.

properties.value: When found, roll 1d20 on the table below to determine the token's power.
A feather token disappears after use.

items.name: Anchor Token
items.description: Causes a water vessel to remain moored in the location where the token is used for one day (or until released).

items.name: Bird Token
items.description: Summons a gargantuan bird for 24 hours. The bird can be commanded to chase aggressive avian creatures away or to transport the character.

properties.value: The bird is powerful enough to carry a huge animal (e.g. a mammoth) or a combination of smaller creatures.
The bird cannot be commanded to attack.

items.name: Fan Token
items.description: At sea, conjures a huge flapping fan which can be commanded to do one of the following for up to 8 hours: 1.  Propel: A single sailing vessel is propelled by high winds, increasing its sailing speed by one half. 2.  Calm: In a storm, gale, or near gale, can create an area of calm or lighter winds. (This does not affect wave size in a storm, however.) (See Waterborne Adventuring in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome for details on sailing and wind.)

items.name: Swan Boat Token
items.description: Conjures a swan-like boat for 24 hours. It can swim without crew or wind, moving at 240' (80'). The boat can hold up to 32 people and has AC 7 [12] and 1d6+3 × 10 hull points.

items.name: Tree Token
items.description: Causes a great oak to spring into being (6' diameter trunk, 60' high, 40' top diameter).

items.name: Whip Token
items.description: Conjures a huge leather whip which attacks on its own for up to 6 turns, at the character's command.

properties.value: THAC0 13 [+6]. Can hit opponents that can only be harmed by magic.
1d6+1. Save versus spells or be entangled (unable to move or act) for 1d6+1 rounds.

items.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power
items.description: A miniature (around 1' tall) statuette carved in the form of an animal. Speaking the correct command word and casting the figurine onto the ground causes it to transform into a living animal which obeys the character's commands.

properties.value: Repeating the command word returns the animal to its figurine form.
It returns to its figurine form.
Its magical power is lost irrevocably.
When a figurine is found, determine its type at random using the following table.

items.name: Ebony Fly
items.description: A fly the size of a pony which may be ridden as a mount. AC 4 [15], HD 4+4 (22hp), Att None, THAC0 15 [+4], MV 480' (160') flying, SV D12 W13 P14 B15 S16 (2), ML 12, AL Neutral, XP 125

properties.value: Moves at 360' (120') with a rider.
3 times a week, for at most 12 hours a day.

items.name: Golden Lion
items.description: A male lion with formidable combat prowess. AC 6 [13], HD 5 (22hp), Att 2 × claw (1d4+1), 1 × bite (1d10), THAC0 15 [+4], MV 150' (50'), SV D12 W13 P14 B15 S16 (3), ML 12, AL Neutral, XP 175

properties.value: Once a day, for up to 1 hour.
Cannot be brought back from statuette form for one full week.

items.name: Ivory Goat of Travelling
items.description: A large goat which can be ridden. AC 6 [13], HD 4 (24hp), Att 2 × horn (1d8), THAC0 16 [+3], MV 480' (160'), SV D12 W13 P14 B15 S16 (2), ML 12, AL Neutral, XP 75

properties.value: Moves at 360' (120') with a rider.
At most 24 hours in the space of a week. After 24 hours of use, the goat cannot be used again for at least 1 day. After 3 uses in total, the goat loses its magic forever.

items.name: Ivory Goat of Travail
items.description: A monstrous goat, larger than a bull. AC 0 [19], HD 16 (96hp), Att 1 × bite (2d4), 2 × hoof (2d4+2), 2 × horn (2d6), THAC0 8 [+11], MV 240' (80'), SV D8 W9 P10 B10 S12 (8), ML 12, AL Neutral, XP 1,350

properties.value: When not in melee. Requires a clear run of at least 20 yards. Horns inflict double damage. May not make bite or hoof attacks when charging.
Once per month for up to 12 hours. After 3 uses in total, the goat loses its magic forever.

items.name: Ivory Goat of Terror
items.description: A giant goat, as large as a warhorse, which may be ridden. The goat's horns become weapons which the rider may wield. AC 2 [17], HD 8* (48hp), Att None, THAC0 12 [+7], MV 360' (120'), SV D12 W13 P14 B15 S16 (2), ML 12, AL Neutral, XP 1,200

properties.value: One horn may be wielded as a lance +3, the other as a sword +3.
When not in melee. Requires a clear run of at least 20 yards. Rider's lance inflicts double damage.
In battle, opponents within 30' must save versus spells or suffer a -3 penalty to attack rolls while the battle lasts.
Once every 2 weeks for up to 3 hours. After 3 uses in total, the goat loses its magic forever.

items.name: Marble Elephant
items.description: A large, tusked elephant that can be used as a beast of burden or commanded to attack. AC 5 [14], HD 9 (40hp), Att 2 × tusk (2d4) or 1 × trample (4d8), THAC0 12 [+7], MV 120' (40'), SV D10 W11 P12 B13 S14 (5), ML 12, AL Neutral, XP 900

properties.value: In first round of combat, when not in melee. Requires a clear run of at least 20 yards. Tusks inflict double damage.
3-in-4 chance of trampling each round. +4 to hit human-sized or smaller creatures.
At most 4 times a month, for up to 24 hours at a time.

items.name: Obsidian Steed
items.description: In figurine form, a vaguely quadruped lump of obsidian. Transforms into a nightmare-an intelligent, demonic horse with glowing red eyes, flaming nostrils, and hooves like smouldering embers. AC -3 [22], HD 6* (27hp), Att 2 × flaming hoof (2d4 + 2), 1 × bite (2d4), THAC0 14 [+5], MV 150' (50') / 360' (120') flying, SV D10 W11 P12 B13 S14 (6), ML 10, AL Chaotic, XP 500

properties.value: Breathe out a choking cloud of burning smoke. Anyone in melee with a nightmare must save versus poison or suffer -2 to attack and damage rolls against the monster.
Once per week, for up to 24 hours.

items.name: Onyx Dog
items.description: A hunting dog with exceptional senses. AC 6 [13], HD 2+2 (11hp), Att 1 × bite (2d4), THAC0 17 [+2], MV 120' (40'), SV D12 W13 P14 B15 S16 (1), ML 11, AL Neutral, XP 25

properties.value: By scent. Once started, very difficult to put off the trail.
65% chance.
Speaks Common.
Once per week, for up to 6 hours.

items.name: Serpentine Owl
items.description: A horned owl with telepathic powers. AC 7 [12], HD ½ (3hp), Att 2 × claw (1d2), THAC0 19 [0], MV 240' (80') flying, SV D12 W13 P14 B15 S16 (1), ML 12, AL Neutral, XP 5

properties.value: On a 1-5, due to silent flight.
Can inform owner of what it sees and hears.
Once per day, for up to 8 hours.

items.name: Flying Carpet
items.description: An enchanted carpet that can fly through the air, carrying up to three passengers (and their gear). The movement rate depends on the number of passengers:

items.name: Folding Boat
items.description: A normal-seeming wooden box (about 1' cube) which magically unfolds into a boat or ship when the correct command word is spoken.

properties.value: One command word causes the box to unfold into a small river boat (length 10' , beam 4' , draft 2'), with oars, a sail, and an anchor. The boat can hold up to 4 human-sized characters and up to 5,000 coins of cargo. It has a movement rate of 150' (50') rowed and 240' (80') sailed, AC 8 [11], and 1d10 + 10 hull points.

Another command word causes the box to unfold into a small sailing ship (length 24' , beam 8' , draft 6'), with 5 sets of oars, a sail, a cabin, and an anchor. The ship can hold up to 15 human-sized characters and up to 15,000 coins of cargo. It has a movement rate of 180' (60') rowed and 360' (180') sailed, AC 8 [11], and 1d20 + 20 hull points.
The boat or ship folds back down into a box when a third command word is uttered.

items.name: Gauntlets of Ogre Power
items.description: A character who wears these gauntlets has a Strength score of 18. This grants all the usual bonuses, including:

properties.value: +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls, in melee.
Deal 1d2+3 damage. Encumbrance: If using the optional rules for detailed encumbrance (see Time, Weight, and Movement in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ):
The character's ability to carry weight is increased by 1,000 coins. (i.e. the character can carry 1,400 coins without becoming encumbered.)

items.name: Gem of Brightness
items.description: A crystal in the shape of a long, rough prism. Three command words cause the crystal to emit three different types of light.

properties.value: The gem has 50 charges.
A beam of pale light, 10' long and 2' wide. Consumes no charges.
A momentary ray of bright light, 50' long and 1' wide to be directed at the eyes of a creature. The target must save versus spells or be blinded for 1d4 rounds. Expends 1 charge.

A momentary cone of blinding light, 30' long and 5' wide at the end. All creatures in the cone must save versus spells or be blinded for 1d4 rounds and suffer a permanent penalty to attack rolls equal to the number of rounds of blindness. The attack penalty can only be cured by powerful magic (e.g. cure serious wounds cast expressly for the purpose). Expends 5 charges.
Negates the effects of the gem.

items.name: Gem of Monster Attraction
items.description: A shining, very valuable-looking gem. A character who takes the gem comes under a curse.

properties.value: Each time the referee checks for wandering monsters, the chance of an encounter is doubled.
If the referee rolls to determine whether monsters pursue the character, the chance of pursuit is doubled.
The jewel reappears, hidden somewhere on the character's person, unless the curse is removed by magic (e.g. remove curse ).

items.name: Gem of Pristine Faceting
items.description: A magical gem which has the power to increase the value of other gems.

properties.value: The gem must be placed with one or more other (non-magical) gems.
There is a 20% chance of each of the other gems being magically polished, faceted, or otherwise perfected in form. Affected gems increase in value by 50%.
The gem has 10d10 charges. One charge is used each time it transforms another gem.
The gem has as many facets as it has charges. Each time a charge is spent, it loses one facet. When all charges have been spent, it becomes a worthless stone sphere.

items.name: Gem of Seeing
items.description: A finely cut, clear gem. Gazing through the gem reveals hidden, enchanted, and invisible things.

properties.value: Are revealed.
Invisible objects and creatures are perceived.
Are seen through.
Enchanted objects and creatures are made apparent.
Up to 30' .
An area of 100 square feet (e.g. ten × 10' squares) can be scanned in one round.
Per usage, there is a 5% chance that the gem will provide false information-a hallucination of something which is not really there.

items.name: Girdle of Giant Strength
items.description: A character who wears this girdle gains the strength of a hill giant.

properties.value: The wearer's ability in combat is augmented: the character attacks as an 8 Hit Dice monster. (If the character already has better attack probabilities, the girdle does not alter these.)
The wearer inflicts 2d8 damage in combat, or twice normal damage, if using the optional variable weapon damage rules (see Combat in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ).

items.name: Gloves of Dexterity
items.description: A pair of soft leather gloves which bestow remarkable manual dexterity.

properties.value: The wearer's DEX increases by a number of points, depending on their normal DEX: 6 or less: +4, 7-13: +2, 14-17: +1.

The wearer may pick pockets, with a 35% chance of success (or a +10% bonus if already able to pick pockets). If the victim is above 5th level, the roll is penalised by 5% for every level above 5th. There is always at least a 1% chance of failure. A roll of more than twice the percentage required for success means that the attempted theft is noticed. The referee should determine the reaction of the victim (possibly using the reaction table under Encounters in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ).

The wearer may pick locks, with a 30% chance of success (or a +10% bonus if already able to open locks). This requires thieves' tools. The character can only try this skill once per lock. If the roll fails, the character may not try the same lock again before gaining an experience level.

items.name: Gloves of Swimming and Climbing
items.description: A pair of soft leather gloves which bestow remarkable swimming and climbing skill.

properties.value: 180' (60') on the surface, 150' (50') underwater. (The ability to breath water is not conferred, however.)

With a 95% chance of success (or 99% if the character can already climb sheer surfaces). A roll is required for each 100' to be climbed. If the roll fails, the character falls at the halfway point, suffering falling damage.

items.name: Helm of Alignment Changing
items.description: A beautifully crafted but cursed helmet.

properties.value: Instantly causes the wearer's alignment to change. The new alignment is determined at random.
The curse is such that the wearer cannot remove the helmet, once in place, and will resist attempts to remove it.
The curse can be removed by magic (e.g. remove curse ), or (at the referee's option) by performing a special quest.

items.name: Helm of Reading Languages and Magic
items.description: A fragile helmet that grants the wearer the ability to read writing of all kinds.

properties.value: Text in any language can be understood.
Even magical writing is comprehensible. (This does not grant the ability to cast spells, however.)
Each time the wearer is hit, there is a 1-in-10 chance of the helm being destroyed. If the wearer is killed, the helm is destroyed.

items.name: Helm of Telepathy
items.description: A beautifully crafted helmet that grants the magical ability of telepathy: reading and sending thoughts.

properties.value: The range of the power is 90' .
To read a creature's thoughts, the wearer must remain still and concentrate on that creature.
The creature's thoughts are made comprehensible to the wearer of the helm.
The wearer may initiate bidirectional, telepathic communication, though the creature is not compelled to respond.

items.name: Helm of Teleportation
items.description: A magical helm that gives an arcane spell caster the ability to cast the teleport spell (see Magic-User Spells in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ).

properties.value: The wearer may teleport themselves, another creature, or an object.
If used on another creature or object, a save versus spells is allowed to resist being teleported.
The helm's power is usable only once.
To be used again, a teleport spell must be cast upon the helm.

The wearer may use the helm an unlimited number of times (at most once per round). If the helm is used on an unwilling subject, it once again loses its power and must be recharged, as above, to be used again.

items.name: Horn of Blasting
items.description: A horn that can be blown to release a blast of destructive noise.

properties.value: Within a 100' long cone (20' wide at the end) suffer 2d6 damage.
Affected creatures are also deafened for one turn ( save versus spells to avoid).

At the referee's discretion, the horn may also be able to damage objects and buildings (e.g. a single blast might be enough to destroy a simple cottage; a 10' section of castle wall might require three blasts).
The horn may be used once per turn.

items.name: Horn of Cave-Ins
items.description: A bugle or hunting horn with the power to cause cave-ins when sounded.

properties.value: A cave-in occurs directly above the character.
The character may aim at a section of roof within 60' . There is a 90% chance that a cave-in occurs in the desired area and a 10% chance that it occurs directly above the character.
Only if blown without speaking the command word: a hail of 2d6 stones cascades onto the character. Each causes 1d6 damage.
The ceiling collapses, causing 6d6 damage to all in a 10' radius. ( Save vs paralysis for half.)

items.name: Horn of Frothing
items.description: A normal-looking musical instrument which is cursed to hamper the owner if blown in perilous circumstances.

properties.value: Blowing the horn has no special effect.
(e.g. in the presence of hostile monsters.) Blowing the horn causes a mass of bubbles to froth out and cover the character's head. This causes blindness for 2d10 rounds.

items.name: Horn of the Tritons
items.description: A large conch shell which has power over marine animals and the seas. Each time it is sounded, one of the following effects may be invoked.

properties.value: In a 1-mile radius.
6d6 hippocampi ( p67 ) or giant sea horses ( p103 ) arrive to obey the character's commands. (Only functions in waters where such animals live.)
Causes marine animals within 240' to flee for 3d6 turns ( save versus spells ).
Once per day. (Tritons may blow the horn up to 3 times per day.)
All tritons within 3 miles hear the sounding of the horn.

items.name: Horn of Valhalla
items.description: An engraved metal hunting horn which summons berserkers to fight for the character.

properties.value: Once per week.
When found, roll d% on the table below to determine the exact powers of the horn.
The number of berserkers summoned and their Hit Dice are shown in the table below.
The berserkers remain until they are slain, have slain their opponents, or 1 hour has passed.
Any character can use the silver horn, but only clerics, fighters, and thieves can use the other types, as indicated in the table below.

If a character of a restricted class blows the horn, the summoned berserkers attack them. Berserker: AC 4 [15], HD 2 to 5 (6hp per HD), Att 1 × weapon (1d6 or by weapon), THAC0 19 [0] (HD 1-3) or 18 [+1] (HD 4-5), MV 120' (40'), SV D12 W13 P14 B15 S16 (HD 1-3) or D10 W11 P12 B13 S14 (HD 4-5), ML 12, AL Neutral, XP 10/20/35/75/175
50% have sword and spear, 50% have battle axe and spear.

items.name: Horseshoes of a Zephyr
items.description: Iron shoes which, when affixed, allow a horse to float slightly above the ground.

properties.value: The horse can move across water as if it were solid ground.
The horse leaves no tracks.
The magic of the shoes is only effective if all 4 are worn.

items.name: Horseshoes of Speed
items.description: Iron horseshoes which, when affixed, double a horse's movement rate.

properties.value: The magic of the shoes is only effective if all 4 are worn.

items.name: Incense of Meditation
items.description: Small blocks of incense which grant boons to a divine spell caster when burned. 2d4 blocks are usually found together.

properties.value: When lit, a distinctive pearly-hued smoke and sweet fragrance are produced. A block burns for 8 hours.
If the divine spell caster who lit the block prays and meditates for 8 hours in the vicinity of the incense, they gain the following boons for 24 hours:
Any variable qualities of spells cast have their maximum value. (e.g. cure light wounds heals the maximum: 7hp).
Saving throws against the character's spells are penalised by -1.

If using the optional rule for returning from death (see Damage, Healing, and Death in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ), resurrection magic used by the character has an increased chance of success. For the sake of the survival roll, the subject's CON is increased by 4.
The unique aroma and smoke can be recognised by divine spell casters of 5th level or higher.

items.name: Incense of Obsession
items.description: Small rectangular blocks of sweet-smelling incense. 2d4 blocks are usually found together. Burning this incense causes a divine spell caster to suffer the delusion that their spell casting ability is greatly enhanced.

properties.value: When lit, the incense produces a distinctive pearly-hued smoke and fragrance, identical to that of incense of meditation . A block burns for 1 hour.
If the divine spell caster who lit the block prays and meditates in the vicinity of the incense, they become obsessed with spell casting.
The character is determined to use their spells at every opportunity, especially when not needed or when useless. The obsession remains until all spells have been cast or until 24 hours have elapsed.

items.name: Instant Fortress
items.description: A small metal cube which can transform into a metal tower 30' tall and 20' square.

properties.value: One command word activates the tower and another returns it to the form of a small metal cube.
The tower springs up in 1 round. Any (except the owner) within 20' must save versus paralysis or suffer 10d6 damage.
The fortress has 3 storeys, arrow slits on all 4 sides, a single entrance door at ground level, and a crenellated battlement atop it.
The door only opens at the owner's command. Knock spells cannot open it.
Stairs lead to each of the 2 upper storeys and the battlement.
The tower is treated as a vehicle (see Vehicles in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ) with AC 5 [14] and 40 hull points. Only a wish can repair it (2 hull points per wish).
The fortress can only be deactivated when it is empty.

items.name: Ioun Stones
items.description: Small, floating stones of different forms and hues. 1d10 are usually found together.

properties.value: When found, roll 1d20 on the table opposite to determine the type of each stone. Duplicate rolls in a single cache of stones indicate a burned out, dull grey stone.
A stone's power is activated when held then released beside the character's head, whereupon it takes up a circling orbit 1d3 feet around the head.
Stones may be grasped or netted to separate them from their owner.
AC 0 [19] and 10hp.
The character may grasp an orbiting stone to store it, deactivating its power temporarily.

items.name: Iron Flask
items.description: A flask of iron, decorated with silver runes and sealed with a sigil-engraved brass plug. The flask-if the appropriate command word is used-has the power to trap an extra-planar being and force it into servitude.

properties.value: There is a 50% chance that a creature (e.g. an elemental, djinni, efreeti, invisible stalker, or other creature of extra-planar origin) is already trapped in the flask.

Frees the trapped creature (if any). If the character speaks the command word, the creature is forced to serve for 1 turn. If the command word is not spoken, the creature's reaction should be determined randomly (see Monster Reactions under Encounters in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ).

If the flask is empty, an extra-planar creature within 60' can be trapped by removing the plug and speaking the command word. The creature may save versus spells to resist. If the creature was previously trapped in the flask, it gains a +2 bonus to the save and becomes utterly hostile.

items.name: Jug of Endless Liquids
items.description: A glass or ceramic jug which can pour forth different liquids on command.

properties.value: If the name of one of the following liquids is spoken out loud and the jug tipped, the liquid will pour forth up to the quantities listed:
Up to 1 vial. Enough to dissolve 1 square foot of wood or metal over 1 turn.
Up to 32 pints.
Up to 64 pints.
Up to 1 pint.
Up to 1 vial. If ingested, the victim suffers 40hp of damage ( save versus poison for half). There is a 40% chance of the poison being detected by scent before drinking.
Up to 128 pints.
Up to 16 pints.
Up to 8 pints.
Up to 1 pint per round.
Each type of liquid may be poured at most once per day.

items.name: Libram of Arcane Power
items.description: A tome of arcane knowledge affiliated with a specific alignment. The effects of opening the tome depend on the class and alignment of the character.

properties.value: Determined by rolling 1d6: 1-2: Lawful, 3-4: Neutral, 5-6: Chaotic.
Once the book's magical effect has occurred, it vanishes.
May study the tome for 1 week to gain one experience level. A character can only gain this benefit once, even if another such libram is discovered.
Suffer 5d4 damage, fall unconscious for 5d4 turns, and become unable to gain experience points unless a quest of atonement is performed.
Must save versus spells or become permanently insane. This insanity can only be removed by magic.

items.name: Loadstone
items.description: A polished, roughly hewn piece of decorative stone (e.g. agate) which afflicts the owner with a curse of slow movement.

properties.value: The curse takes effect when the character attempts to flee from an enemy (whether in combat or in pursuit).
The character's movement rate is halved and they can only attack or cast spells every second round.
The stone reappears, hidden somewhere on the character's person, unless the curse is removed by magic (e.g. remove curse ).

items.name: Luckstone
items.description: A polished, roughly hewn piece of decorative stone (e.g. agate) which grants its owner good luck.

properties.value: The character gains a +1 (or +5%, as applicable) bonus to saving throws, ability checks, and similar rolls.

items.name: Lyre of Building
items.description: A beautifully crafted musical instrument which, when played by a skilled musician, has magical abilities of construction.

properties.value: Once per day, playing the proper chords (treat as a command word) negates the effects of attacks made against a building or construction. This can, for example, negate the powers of a horn of blasting (see p59 ) or the effects of siege weapons.

Once per week, playing the proper chords (treat as a command word) allows buildings to be magically constructed.  Construction work equivalent to that of 100 humans over 3 days occurs in merely 3 turns.
There is a 50% chance of the effects of the lyre being negated.

items.name: Marvellous Pigments
items.description: Pots of magical paint which can be applied to a flat surface to conjure a real, three-dimensional object. 1d4 pots of pigment are usually found together, along with a brush.

properties.value: The object to be conjured must be painted onto a flat surface (e.g. wall, door, floor, ceiling). The artistic skill of the character has no bearing-the object magically flows from the paint brush, guided by the character's imagination alone.
Painting an object takes 1 turn.
Each pot of the pigments is sufficient to cover a 10' × 10' surface, conjuring an object of up to 1,000 cubic feet (e.g. 10' × 10' × 10').
Only non-magical, inanimate things may be conjured, for example: rooms, portals, armour, equipment, trees, flowers, pits, passages, etc.
May be conjured. These appear valuable, but are actually constructed of low value materials (e.g. tin, glass, etc.).
Conjured objects are permanent and real in every sense.

items.name: Medallion of ESP 30'
items.description: A medallion on a chain, enchanted with the power of reading thoughts.

properties.value: By concentrating for 1 round, the wearer may target a creature within 30' .
At the referee's option, the target may save versus spells to resist.
While reading thoughts, the wearer may move, but cannot cast spells or attack.
The medallion is not entirely reliable. Per usage, there is a 1-in-6 chance of it misfiring, instead sending the wearer's thoughts to all within 30' .

items.name: Medallion of ESP 90'
items.description: A medallion on a chain, enchanted with the power of reading thoughts. This works in the same way as the magic-user spell ESP (see Magic-User Spells in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ).

items.name: Medallion of Thought Projection
items.description: A medallion on a chain, enchanted with the power of reading thoughts, but cursed such that it also projects the wearer's thoughts to others.

properties.value: By concentrating for 1 round, the wearer may target a creature within 30' .
At the referee's option, the target may save versus spells to resist.
While reading thoughts, the wearer may move, but cannot cast spells or attack.
When used, there is a 5-in-6 chance that the curse of the medallion will project the wearer's thoughts to all within 30' , alerting them to the wearer's presence nearby.

items.name: Mirror of Life Trapping
items.description: A mirror with the ability to magically trap living creatures behind its pane.

properties.value: Any creature of human size or smaller who gazes into the mirror is sucked inside ( save versus spells to resist), with all its belongings.
Up to 20 creatures can be trapped in the mirror. When this number is reached, it becomes safe to look into the mirror.
A creature will live indefinitely, without the need for air or sustenance, and unaffected by ageing.
Trapped creatures may converse with those outside, but are utterly powerless.
Releases those trapped.

items.name: Mirror of Mental Prowess
items.description: A large looking glass, 5' tall and 2' wide, which bestows several magical powers on the character who possesses it.

properties.value: The character can read the thoughts of anyone whose reflection is viewed in the mirror, even if the thoughts are in an unknown language.

Up to 3 times per day, gain a vision (accompanied with sound) of a place or object that is brought to mind. The clarity of the vision is dependant on the scryer's familiarity with the subject. It is not possible to cast spells through the mirror into the viewed scene.

When scrying, the character may choose to step into the mirror, appearing in the observed location. This works the same as the 6th level illusionist spell through the looking glass . (See the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome .)
Once per week, a short question about a creature whose reflection is viewed in the mirror. The answer will be true but brief.

items.name: Mirror of Opposition
items.description: A looking glass, 4' tall and 3' wide, which brings to life a double of anyone reflected in its surface.

properties.value: Will step out of the mirror, magically brought to life, and attack the original.
Have the same statistics, abilities (including spells), and equipment as the original.
If the mirror opposite or the original is killed, the mirror opposite disappears with all its equipment.

items.name: Necklace of Adaptation
items.description: A heavy chain with a medallion, which grants the wearer the ability to survive without breathing.

properties.value: Do not affect the wearer.
The wearer can survive underwater, in a vacuum, or any other airless environment.

items.name: Necklace of Fireballs
items.description: A cheap-looking medallion which allows one who wears it to throw fireballs.

properties.value: When found, roll 1d20 on the table below to determine the powers of the necklace.
One who wears the necklace can perceive its true form: a golden chain hung with small golden spheres.
The golden spheres can be detached and thrown up to 70' , exploding in a fireball.
Golden spheres which explode into higher damage fireballs are larger.
Inflict the listed damage on all in a 20' radius ( save versus spells for half damage).

properties.key: If wearer is harmed by magical fire
properties.value: They must save versus spells. If the save fails, all remaining golden spheres explode immediately.

items.name: Necklace of Strangulation
items.description: A fabulous jewelled necklace which is cursed to strangle anyone who wears it.

properties.value: The necklace constricts around the character's neck, inflicting 6 points of damage per round.
The necklace can only be removed by magic (e.g. remove curse ).
The necklace remains constricted in place until the corpse has rotted away (about 1 month). It then loosens, ready for another victim.

items.name: Net of Snaring
items.description: A 10' square net of meshed rope with the power to ensnare creatures.

properties.value: Can be thrown up to 20' . Creatures must save versus spells or be trapped.
A command word causes the net to drop.
A command word can cause the net to close upwards.
Only creatures of giant strength can escape ensnarement. The strands of the net cannot be cut or damaged by mundane means.

items.name: Net of Aquatic Snaring
items.description: Only functions underwater.

items.name: Oil of Insubstantiality
items.description: A flask of thin oil which has the power to make characters or objects insubstantial.

properties.value: The oil must be rubbed onto the character or object to be affected. A flask is sufficient for one human-sized character and their gear.
The subject becomes insubstantial-able to move through physical objects like a ghost. The subject can only be harmed by magic.
1d4+4 turns.

items.name: Oil of Slipperiness
items.description: A flask of thin oil which can make characters or objects impossible to grasp.

properties.value: The oil must be rubbed onto the character or object to be affected. A flask is sufficient for one human-sized character and their gear.
The subject becomes impossible to grasp or restrain, making them immune to constriction attacks and able to instantly slip out of webs, rope bonds, chains, and so forth.
A flask can cover a 10' square area. Creatures walking through the area have a 95% chance per round of slipping over.
8 hours.

items.name: Pearl of Power
items.description: A magical pearl which grants an arcane spell caster the ability to recall cast spells.

properties.value: The character may instantly re-memorize one spell which has already been cast. The spell must be among those which the character most recently memorized.
When found, roll 1d20 on the table below to determine the maximum level of spell which may be recalled.
The pearl's power may be used once per day.

items.name: Pearl of Wisdom
items.description: A normal-looking pearl which increases the Wisdom of a divine spell caster who keeps it on their person.

properties.value: The character's WIS increases by 1 (maximum of 18) as long as the pearl is on their person.
The character must keep the pearl on their person for 30 days in order for it to take effect.

items.name: Periapt of Foul Rotting
items.description: A small gem of apparently inconsequential value which curses its possessor with a horrible rotting disease.

properties.value: The character loses 1 point of CHA, CON, and DEX per week, beginning one week after coming into possession of the gem.
If any afflicted ability score reaches 0, the character dies.
The curse must first be removed (e.g. with remove curse ) before the disease may be cured (e.g. cure disease ).
The gem is engraved with magical sigils which can only be seen by magic.

items.name: Periapt of Health
items.description: A small gem of apparently inconsequential value which protects its possessor against disease.

properties.value: While the gem is on the character's person, they are immune to all forms of disease (including magical disease), except the disease caused by the cursed periapt of foul rotting .

items.name: Periapt of Proof Against Poison
items.description: A small gem of apparently inconsequential value which protects its possessor against poison.

properties.value: When found, roll 1d10 on the table below to determine the magnitude of the periapt's power.
The periapt protects its owner against poisons. The effect depends on the type of saving throw allowed by the poison:
The character has a percentage chance of resisting the poison.
The character rolls the save without the penalty.
The character gains a bonus to the saving throw.

items.name: Periapt of Wound Closure
items.description: A small gem of apparently inconsequential value which protects its possessor against wounding.

properties.value: The character is immune to effects which cause damage by bleeding.
The character regains hit points from rest at twice the normal rate (2d3hp per day of rest).
The character can heal magically non-healable damage normally.

items.name: Phylactery of Betrayal
items.description: A small box containing strips of parchment inscribed with holy text. Carries a curse which attracts enemies of a divine spell caster's religion.

properties.value: The phylactery must be strapped to the arm.

Once strapped on, the phylactery's curse is activated. Enemies of the character's religion (e.g. powerful monsters of the opposite alignment, priests of opposing religions, etc.) are alerted to the character's presence when within 120' .
Once the curse is active, the character cannot remove the phylactery. The curse can only be removed with magic (e.g. remove curse ).

items.name: Phylactery of Faithfulness
items.description: A small box containing strips of parchment inscribed with holy text. Can forewarn a divine spell caster of actions or items which could cause deity disfavour.

properties.value: The phylactery must be strapped to the arm.
The character must briefly contemplate a course of action or item.
The phylactery forewarns the character if the contemplated course of action or item would cause the character to change alignment or otherwise bring about deity disfavour.

items.name: Phylactery of Longevity
items.description: A small box containing strips of parchment inscribed with holy text. Has the power to slow a divine spell caster's ageing process.

properties.value: The phylactery must be strapped to the arm.
The character ages at ¾ of the normal rate. For example, after 4 years wearing the phylactery, the character is only 3 years older.

items.name: Pipes of the Sewers
items.description: A set of wooden musical pipes with the power to summon and control rats.

properties.value: The magical effect is only activated by playing a specific melody, which must be learned (treat as a command word).
If rats are within 400' , playing the correct melody summons either 1d6 × 10 giant rats or 3d6 × 10 normal rats (see p97 ).
Summoned rats travel towards the character's location at a rate of 50' per round.
Summoned rats have a 95% chance of obeying the character's mental commands, as long as they keep playing the pipes.
Summoned rats leave immediately. If playing is resumed, there is a 70% chance of the rats obeying the character once more and a 30% chance of them attacking the character.

The pipes can also be played to take over control of rats controlled by another (e.g. by a vampire or wererat). There is a 30% chance of success per round. If successful, the other creature may attempt to reassert control, also with a 30% chance per round.

items.name: Portable Hole
items.description: A 6' diameter circle of fine black cloth, often found folded down to the size of a handkerchief. The cloth can be placed upon a surface (floor, wall, ceiling, etc.) to conjure an extra-dimensional hole.

properties.value: Creates a 6' diameter, 10' deep hole in the surface.
When placed upon a surface, the cloth can be picked up by a creature inside or outside of the hole. The hole then disappears from the surface it was placed on.
Remains in an extra-dimensional space when the cloth is picked up.
Can unfold the cloth (if they have it) to recreate the hole at its last location. The hole contains enough air for one turn.

items.name: Purse of Plentiful Coin
items.description: A small leather pouch which can magically duplicate coins placed inside it.

properties.value: Filled with 26 coins of each type (cp, sp, ep, gp, pp).
Each morning, duplicates any coins left in it, producing up to 25 coins of each type it contains. (e.g. if a single gold piece is left in the pouch, the following day it will contain 26gp.)
The purse permanently loses its magical power.

items.name: Restorative Ointment
items.description: A jar of magical unguent which can cure wounds, disease, and poisons. 1d3 jars are usually found together. Each jar contains 5 doses.

properties.value: A dose cures 1d4 + 8 hp.
A dose cures any disease.
A dose cures any poison.

items.name: Robe of Blending
items.description: A normal-looking robe with powers of disguise and camouflage.

properties.value: The character can blend into natural environments (e.g. rock walls, undergrowth).

When among creatures of another type, the character can choose to appear as one of them. The other type of creature may not be larger than twice the character's normal size or smaller than half their normal size.
Observers of high intelligence (e.g. INT 15 or more) or with 10 or more Hit Dice have a 1-in-6 chance per turn of spotting the character.
Can see the character normally.

items.name: Robe of Eyes
items.description: A luxurious robe adorned with dozens of eye motifs. Donning the robe grants the following magical visual powers:

properties.value: The robe's visual powers prevent the character from being surprised.
The character can see in all directions at once.
Within 120' .
The character sees creatures using displacement effects (e.g. a displacer cloak) in their true location.
The character can plainly see anyone hiding or using camouflage.
A light spell cast directly on the robe causes the character to be blinded for 1d3 rounds. Continual light causes blindness for 2d4 rounds.

items.name: Robe of Powerlessness
items.description: A cursed robe which weakens one who dons it.

properties.value: Reduced to STR 3.
Reduced to INT 3.
The character loses all magical ability and cannot cast spells.
Does not remove the curse. This must be removed by magic (e.g. remove curse ).

items.name: Robe of Scintillating Colours
items.description: A normal-looking robe that can conjure a hypnotic pattern of incredible hues.

properties.value: Only a character with at least 15 INT and 13 WIS can use the robe's magic.
The colours on the robe begin flowing in the round following the activation of its magic.
Creatures within 40' that see the hypnotic pattern must save versus spells or stand transfixed for 1d4+1 rounds (unable to move or act). Following this period, another save is allowed.
The character gains a +1 AC bonus per round the pattern is active (to a maximum bonus of +5, after 5 rounds).
In order to maintain the pattern, the character must not move more than 10' per round. Casting spells and other actions are possible.

items.name: Robe of the Archmagi
items.description: A normal-looking robe which grants a variety of magical boons to an arcane spell caster of suitable alignment.

properties.value: When found, roll 1d20 to determine the robe's alignment: 1-9: lawful, 10-15: neutral, 16-20: chaotic.
Upon donning the robe, an arcane spell caster whose alignment differs from that of the robe suffers 6d4 damage and changes alignment to that of the robe.
Donning a robe grants the following powers:
+1 bonus to all saves.
When the character casts charm , hold , or polymorph spells, the target suffers a -4 penalty to the saving throw.

items.name: Robe of Useful Items
items.description: A plain-looking robe with the power to conjure objects out of thin air.

properties.value: After donning the robe, they notice a series of cloth patches sewn into it, shaped like items.
Cannot perceive or use the powers of this robe.
Takes 1 round. The patch permanently turns into the corresponding item.
The robe has the following patches when found:
a. Two daggers.
b. Two 10' poles.
c. Two lanterns, lit and filled with oil.
d. Two large sacks.
e. Two steel, hand-sized mirrors.
f. Two 50' ropes.
g. 4d4 items rolled on the table below.

items.name: Robe of Useful Items: Item Type
items.description: d% Item 01-08 Bag of 100gp 09-15 Small silver box (worth 500gp) 16-22 Iron door with a bar on one side; may be attached to a wall 23-30 10 gems (worth 100gp each) 31-44 Wooden ladder, 24' long 45-51 Mule with saddle bags 52-59 10' deep pit 60-68 Potion that heals 2d6+2 hp 69-75 Rowing boat (12' long, movement rate 30' (10'), AC 9 [10], 10 hull points) 76-83 Scroll of a random arcane spell 84-90 Two war dogs (see below) 91-00 Window (2' × 4' , 2' deep) War dogs: AC 6 [13], HD 2+2 (11hp), Att 1 × bite (2d4), THAC0 17 [+2], MV 120' (40'), SV D12 W13 P14 B15 S16 (1), ML 11, AL Neutral, XP 25

items.name: Rope of Climbing
items.description: A coil of thin, strong rope, 50' in length.

properties.value: The owner may command it to climb in any direction.
The rope can also be commanded to attach to a surface.
Up to 10,000 coins of weight can be suspended from the rope.

items.name: Rope of Entanglement
items.description: A 50' length of rope with the power to entangle enemies.

properties.value: The owner can command the rope to entangle up to 8 human-sized creatures (or a number of larger or smaller creatures equivalent to 8 humans).
Up to 20' forward or 10' up.
Each target may save versus spells to avoid being entangled.
Are fully restrained: unable to move, cast spells, or free themselves in any way.
It has AC -2 [21] and 22 hit points. If cut through, the rope becomes non-magical.
The rope repairs any damage to itself in 6 turns.

items.name: Rope of Strangulation
items.description: A cursed 50' rope which strangles any who attempt to activate its magic.

properties.value: Any command issued to the rope by a character holding it activates its curse.
The rope springs to life and attempts to strangle the character holding it plus 1d4 others within 10' .
Each victim may save versus spells to avoid being strangled.
Suffer 2d6 damage per round, cannot cast spells, and are unable to free themselves in any way.
Dispel magic causes the rope to release the victims, as does severing it.
It has AC -2 [21] and 22 hit points. If cut through, the rope becomes non-magical.

items.name: Rug of Suffocation
items.description: A high quality, woven carpet which is cursed to smother any who attempt to activate its magic.

properties.value: Any command issued to the rug by a character sitting on it activates its curse.
The rug rolls up tightly around the character and attempts to suffocate them.
The victim may save versus spells to avoid being suffocated.
The character suffocates in 1d4+2 rounds.
Dispel magic causes the rug to release the victim.

items.name: Saw of Felling
items.description: A magical saw-blade of adamantine, 12' long and 1' wide, with the power to saw through trunks at a fantastic speed.

properties.value: A character of STR 18 can operate the saw alone. Two characters of STR 17 can operate it together.
The saw can cut through a 4' thick trunk in 3 turns, a 2' trunk in 1 turn, and a 1' trunk in 3 rounds.
After 6 turns of sawing, a character must rest for 6 turns.

items.name: Scarab of Chaos
items.description: A small, scarab-shaped amulet with the power to drive those who see it temporarily insane.

properties.value: 1d8+8 charges.
The owner must present the scarab and utter a command word to activate its magic.
Creatures within 20' must save versus spells (with a -2 penalty) or become temporarily insane.
Affected creatures cannot cast spells and act completely irrationally. Each round, roll for the behaviour of each subject on the table below.
1d4+8 rounds.

items.name: Scarab of Death
items.description: A small, scarab-shaped brooch which carries a curse to kill anyone who possesses it.

properties.value: The scarab's curse is activated when a character holds it for more than 1 round or when a character carries it on their person for more than 1 turn.
The scarab comes to life and tears through leather, cloth, and flesh, seeking the character's heart. This takes one round and causes death.
The scarab cannot tear through wood, ceramic, bone, ivory, or metal. If placed in a container of one of those materials, it remains inert even when carried.

items.name: Scarab of Protection
items.description: Protects the bearer from baleful magic.

properties.value: Of all kinds are nullified.
(see the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ) is nullified.
The scarab's enchantment works 2d6 times before it is spent.

items.name: Scarab of Rage
items.description: A small, scarab-shaped amulet with the power to instil a blood rage in those who see it.

properties.value: 1d6+18 charges.
The owner must present the scarab and utter a command word to activate its magic.
Intelligent enemies within 40' are stricken with blood rage ( save versus spells to avoid).

Affected creatures immediately attack the closest creature, whether it is friend or foe. If the creature is killed, the stricken creature attacks the next nearest. The rage causes a +1 bonus to attack rolls, a +2 bonus to damage rolls, and a -3 AC penalty.
1d6+6 rounds.

items.name: Spade of Mighty Digging
items.description: A magical spade with an 8' long handle and a 3' long head. The spade has the power to excavate earth at a fantastic speed.

properties.value: Only a character of STR 18 or greater can use the spade.
The spade can excavate a cubic yard of hard clay in 2 rounds, a cubic yard of normal earth in 1 round, and a 2 cubic yards of loose soil in 1 round.
After 10 rounds of digging, the character must rest for 5 rounds.

items.name: Sphere of Annihilation
items.description: A rift in the fabric of the multiverse which manifests as a static 2' globe of absolute blackness. Anything it touches is utterly destroyed.

properties.value: Any matter which touches the sphere is instantly and permanently annihilated. Restoration is impossible, even with a wish.
An arcane spell caster may try to move the sphere with their mind. The character must be at most 10' per level away from the sphere. Any attempt to move the sphere sets it in motion.
A control check is required each round. The chance of success depends on the character's level, as shown in the table below.
The character can move the sphere in any direction for 1 round, at the rate shown in the table.
The sphere slides towards the character at a rate of 10' for 1d4 rounds. Control cannot be reattempted during this time.

If multiple arcane spell casters vie for control of the sphere, each must make a control check per round, with the highest level character rolling first. If all characters fail to control the sphere, it slides towards the highest level character as per if a check fails , above.

items.name: Sweet Water
items.description: A vial of scintillating liquid with the power to transmute liquids into pure, drinkable water.

properties.value: The vial of sweet water must be poured into the liquid to be purified. The volume transmuted depends on the type of the other liquid.
Up to 100,000 cubic feet.
Up to 1,000 cubic feet.
One potion. (Rendered non-magical.)
Up to 6 quarts.

items.name: Talisman of the Sphere
items.description: An adamantine loop and handle which can increase an arcane spell caster's control over a sphere of annihilation .

properties.value: Using the talisman when attempting to control a sphere of annihilation allows the character to add their INT score to the control chance. If a control check succeeds, the character can then move the sphere for 2 rounds before having to make another control check.
Suffer 5d6 damage when touching the talisman.

items.name: Vacuous Grimoire
items.description: A cursed tome which can diminish a character's mental faculties.

properties.value: The tome adapts its appearance to blend in with any other books in its vicinity.
Opening the book and reading so much as a single word of the text afflicts the character with the baleful magic.
Lose 1 point of INT ( save vs spells to avoid) and 2 points of WIS ( save vs spells to avoid).
The grimoire is impervious to physical harm, except if remove curse is cast upon it first.

items.name: Well of Many Worlds
items.description: A 6' diameter circle of fine black cloth, often found folded down to the size of a handkerchief. The cloth can be placed upon a surface to conjure a gateway to another world.

properties.value: Creates a 6' diameter hole in the surface.
Is transported to another world, plane, or dimension (as determined by the referee).
An identical hole exists at the destination location in the other world, allowing transit back and forth.
When placed upon a surface, picking up the cloth causes the hole to disappear. The cloth can be picked up from either world.
Picking up the hole and placing it in a different location opens a gateway to a different world, plane, or dimension. 194 195

items.name: Potion of Clairaudience
items.description: Enables the character to hear through the ears of another creature.

properties.value: The other creature must be within 60' .
