Lead blocks the effect.

items.name: Potion of Clairvoyance
items.description: Enables the character to see through the eyes of another creature.

properties.value: The other creature must be within 60' .
Lead blocks the effect.

items.name: Potion of Control
items.description: A potion of this type allows the one who drinks it to control the actions of creatures of a certain type.

properties.value: Exercising control requires concentration.
The character can only control creatures that they can see.
Controlled creatures will resist commands that are deadly to themselves.
Up to 3d6 Hit Dice of normal or giant (but not magical) animals.
Affected animals will move away.
1-3 dragons of a specific type. (The referee should determine which type of dragon the potion affects.)
It is not possible to command a dragon to cast spells.
Affected dragons have a hostile reaction.
1-4 giants of a specific type. (The referee should determine which type of giant the potion affects.)
A charm may be placed upon a human within 60' . One target may be charmed per round.
The subject may save versus spells to resist the charm.
Up to 6 Hit Dice of humans may be charmed in this way. Normal humans count as ½ HD.

Regard the character as a trusted friend, and will come to their defence. They will obey the character's commands, as long as these are not obviously harmful and do not contradict the subject's alignment.
All plants (including plant monsters) in a 30' square area up to 60' distant.
Affected plants may be commanded to move around as the character wishes, and may be used to entangle creatures in the area.
Up to 3d6 Hit Dice of undead.
Affected undead have a hostile reaction.

items.name: Potion of Delusion
items.description: A character who drinks this potion believes is under the effects of another type of potion.

properties.value: The other type of potion should be determined by the referee.
The referee should try to trick the player into believing that the character is under the effects of the other potion, only revealing the truth at some vital juncture.

items.name: Potion of Diminution
items.description: The character shrinks to 6' high.

properties.value: While shrunk, the character is unable to harm creatures larger than 1' tall.
The character can slip through narrow spaces.
The character only has a 10% chance of being spotted.

items.name: Potion of ESP
items.description: Grants the power of reading thoughts. This works in the same way as the magic-user spell ESP (see Magic-User Spells in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ). The standard potion duration applies.

items.name: Potion of Fire Resistance
items.description: Grants protection against fire:

properties.value: Unharmed by non-magical heat or fire.
Gain a +2 bonus to all saving throws versus fire-based magical or breath attacks.
Is reduced by 1 point per damage die rolled. (Each die inflicts a minimum of 1 hit point damage.)

items.name: Potion of Flying
items.description: Grants the ability to fly through the air.

properties.value: Is possible in any direction, including the ability to levitate and to hover in mid-air.

items.name: Potion of Gaseous Form
items.description: The character's body becomes a cloud of vapour. This has the following effects:

properties.value: Drops to the floor.
The character may move, as a cloud of gas, through small cracks in stone walls, wooden objects, etc.
Is not possible, while in gaseous form.
The character's AC is -2 [21]. Non-magical weapons cannot harm the character.

items.name: Potion of Giant Strength
items.description: Grants the strength of a frost giant.

properties.value: Inflict double damage.
The character may throw boulders for 3d6 damage, with a range of up to 200' .
The effects of this potion are not cumulative with other magic items that augment strength (e.g. a girdle of giant strength ).

items.name: Potion of Growth
items.description: The character doubles in size.

properties.value: The character's increased strength means that their melee attacks deal double damage.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: Has one of two effects on the character who drinks it: 1.  Healing a living subject: Restores 1d6+1 hit points of damage. This cannot grant more hit points than the subject's normal maximum. 2.  Curing paralysis: Paralysing effects are negated.

items.name: Potion of Heroism
items.description: Normal humans and characters of a combat-focused, non-magic using class (e.g. dwarf, fighter, halfling) who drink a potion of heroism temporarily gain additional levels. The number of levels gained depends on the character's normal experience level:

properties.value: Gain the abilities of a 4th level fighter.
Gain 3 levels.
Gain 2 levels.
Gain 1 level.

No effect. Effects: All abilities of the additional levels are gained, including extra hit points. Damage: Damage suffered while under the effects of this potion is first deducted from the pool of additional hit points granted.

items.name: Potion of Invisibility
items.description: Drinking this potion, the character becomes invisible. This works the same as the magic-user spell invisibility (see Magic-User Spells in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ). The standard potion duration applies.

properties.value: At the referee's discretion, a potion of invisibility may be consumed in six smaller doses, each with a reduced duration.

items.name: Potion of Invulnerability
items.description: The character is magically protected from harm, gaining the following benefits:

properties.value: A +2 AC bonus.
A +2 bonus to all saves.
If a character consumes more than one potion of invulnerability in the space of a week, the effects are inverted (a -2 penalty to AC and saves).

items.name: Potion of Levitation
items.description: The character gains the ability to move up and down through the air at will.

properties.value: The character mentally directs vertical movement at up to 60' per round.
The character can push against solid objects to move laterally.
A normal amount of weight can be carried while levitating.

items.name: Potion of Longevity
items.description: Instantly and permanently causes the character to become 10 years younger.

items.name: Potion of Poison
items.description: Appears the same as any other potion.

properties.value: Causes death ( save vs poison ).
Even a sip has the full effect.

items.name: Potion of Polymorph Self
items.description: Upon drinking this potion, the character transforms into another being (of their choice). This works in the same way as the magic-user spell polymorph self (see Magic-User Spells in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ). The standard potion duration applies.

items.name: Potion of Speed
items.description: The character's movements and actions are magically accelerated.

properties.value: Movement rate is doubled.
The number of attacks per round the character can make is doubled.
May be performed at double speed.

items.name: Potion of Treasure Finding
items.description: Grants the ability to sense treasure.

properties.value: Treasure up to 360' away can be detected.
The character gains an awareness of the direction and distance of treasure.
The character must concentrate in order to sense this information.
The largest treasure hoard within range is sensed.
The magic is blocked by lead.

items.name: Ring of Controlling Animals
items.description: Grants the power to control the actions of animals.

properties.value: 1d6 normal animals or 1 giant animal (not magical or intelligent animals).
No saving throw is allowed.
The character can only control animals that they can see.
Control is broken if the user of the ring moves or attacks.
The referee should make a reaction roll with a -1 penalty (see Encounters in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ) to determine the animals' behaviour.
May be used up to once per turn.

items.name: Ring of Controlling Humans
items.description: Grants the power to charm humans.

properties.value: A charm may be placed upon a human within 60' . One target may be charmed per round.
The subject may save versus spells (with a -2 penalty) to resist.
Up to 6 Hit Dice of humans may be charmed in this way. Normal humans count as ½ HD.

Regard the character as a trusted friend, and will come to their defence. They will obey the character's commands, as long as these are not obviously harmful and do not contradict the subject's alignment.
The charm lasts until dispelled, until the ring is removed, or until the wearer cancels it.

items.name: Ring of Controlling Plants
items.description: Grants the power to control plants.

properties.value: All plants (including plant monsters) in a 10' square area.
The area may be up to 60' distant.
Affected plants may be commanded to move around as the character wishes.
The effect lasts as long as the wearer of the ring concentrates.

items.name: Ring of Delusion
items.description: The wearer believes is under the effects of another type of magic ring.

properties.value: The other type of ring should be determined by the referee (e.g. a ring of protection or a ring of spell turning).
The referee should try to trick the player into believing that the character is under the effects of the other ring, only revealing the truth at some vital juncture.

items.name: Ring of Djinni Summoning
items.description: This ring grants the power to summon a lesser djinni (see p38 ).

properties.value: The djinni will serve the character who summoned it for up to 24 hours.
The djinni only obeys the one who summoned it-another character who takes the ring has no power over the djinni.
The ring may be used up to once per day.

items.name: Ring of Fire Resistance
items.description: Grants the wearer protection against fire.

properties.value: Unharmed by non-magical fire.
Gain a +2 bonus to all saving throws versus fire-based magical or breath attacks.
Is reduced by 1 point per damage die rolled. (Each die inflicts a minimum of 1 hit point damage.)

items.name: Ring of Invisibility
items.description: The wearer of this ring becomes invisible.

properties.value: If the character attacks or casts a spell, the invisibility is broken.
May be used up to once per turn.

items.name: Ring of Protection
items.description: Grants a measure of protection from harm:

properties.value: A +1 AC bonus.
A +1 bonus to all saves.

items.name: Ring of Protection, 5' Radius
items.description: Allies within 5' of the wearer also benefit from the ring's protective power. For example, two characters fighting beside the wearer of the ring would gain the protective benefit.

items.name: Ring of Regeneration
items.description: The wearer heals at an accelerated rate.

properties.value: The wearer regains 1 hit point per round.
Will also regrow. The rate depends on the size of the limb (e.g. a finger may regrow in one day, while a whole limb may take a week).
Cannot be regenerated.
The ring does not function if the wearer is reduced to 0 or less hit points.

items.name: Ring of Spell Storing
items.description: Stores a number of magical spells that the wearer can release on command.

properties.value: The ring contains 1d6 spells. (The spells can be triggered and recharged, but cannot be changed.)
There is a 20% chance of divine spells, otherwise they are arcane spells.
The wearer of the ring knows which spells it contains.
The wearer of the ring can trigger the spells at will (up to one spell per round).
For spells whose effects vary by the level of the caster, the wearer of the ring is treated as a caster of the lowest level required to cast the spell.
Once a spell is triggered, it may not be reused until it is recharged-the expired spell must be cast directly onto the ring.

items.name: Ring of Spell Turning
items.description: Spells cast on the wearer of this ring are reflected back onto the caster.

properties.value: After 2d6 spells are reflected, the ring loses its power.

items.name: Ring of Telekinesis
items.description: Grants the power to move objects or creatures within 120' by concentrating.

properties.value: Up to 2,000 coins of weight may be targeted.
The target may be moved up to 20' per round, in whatever direction the wearer of the ring wishes (including vertically).
A targeted creature may save versus spells to resist.
If concentration is broken, the target falls.

items.name: Ring of Water Walking
items.description: Grants the power to walk on the surface of water, without sinking.

items.name: Ring of Weakness
items.description: A cursed ring that weakens the wearer.

properties.value: Within 6 rounds of putting the ring on, the wearer's STR is reduced to 3.
The ring cannot be removed, once worn.
The curse can be removed by magic (e.g. remove curse ), or (at the referee's option) by performing a special quest.

items.name: Ring of Wishes
items.description: Grants the wearer's wishes (see p149 ).

properties.value: The number of wishes granted is noted in the Rings table. Once all wishes have been used, the ring's magic is spent.

items.name: Ring of X-Ray Vision
items.description: Grants the power to see through solid objects.

properties.value: Sight up to 60' through less dense materials (cloth, water, wood) is possible.
Sight up to 30' through stone is possible.
Sight through gold or lead is blocked.

When used for the purpose of searching (see Dungeon Adventuring in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ), the wearer is guaranteed to notice secret doors or traps in the 10' square area being examined.
Using the ring requires concentration (the wearer cannot move).
May be used at most once per turn. 204

items.name: Immovable Rod
items.description: A 4' length of metal which has the power to anchor itself to a point in space.

properties.value: The rod attacks as a +2 magic item, doing 1d6 damage. It can be hurled (range: 5'-20' / 21'-40' / 41'-60').
A command word causes the rod to anchor itself to its current position in space. Once anchored, it can only be moved by a wish. (Even gravity does not move the rod.)
A second command word unanchors the rod.
If the rod is in motion when anchored, it continues its previous direction and speed of movement.
Does not use charges; may be used an unlimited number of times.

items.name: Rod of Absorption
items.description: Absorbs spells cast at the character and uses the absorbed energy to cast the character's own spells.

properties.value: Only usable by spell casters (divine or arcane).
When a spell is cast at the character, the rod absorbs its energy, negating its effect. This uses one charge per level of the spell. The rod gains an equal number of stored energy levels.

May be used to cast spells which the character has memorized. When doing so, a number of stored energy levels are expended equal to the level of the spell cast. Spells cast in this way are not lost from the character's memory.
The rod has 50 charges.

items.name: Rod of Cancellation
items.description: Drains the enchantment from a magic item that is touched.

properties.value: Usage requires an attack roll against AC 9 [10] (adjusted by the referee, if the target item is being actively used).
The item that is touched becomes utterly non-magical.
The rod may only be used once: it has but a single charge.

items.name: Rod of Captivation
items.description: Beguiles creatures of all kinds.

properties.value: All intelligent creatures (including those of animal intelligence) within 20' are charmed.
Creatures of human-level intelligence may save versus spells (with a -2 penalty) to resist.
Regard the character as their trusted friend and ally and will come to the character's defence.
If they share a language, the character may give the charmed creatures commands, which they will obey.
Commands that contradict a charmed creature's nature or alignment may be ignored.
An affected creature never obeys suicidal or obviously harmful orders.
1 turn.

items.name: Rod of Lordly Might
items.description: A thick metal rod with a spherical head and a set of 8 studs along the shaft. Pressing the studs activates a variety of magical and mundane effects.

properties.value: Only usable by non-spell casting martial characters (e.g. fighters).
The rod may be wielded as a mace +2. If the wielder has a STR of less than 16, they suffer a -2 penalty to attack rolls, due to the rod's weight.
Have the following effects:
A creature touched must save vs spells or be paralysed for 6 turns. This consumes one charge.
Creatures within a 60' cone (30' wide at the end) must save versus spells or flee in terror for 10 rounds. This consumes one charge.
A creature hit with the rod in melee (requiring an attack roll) suffers 2d4 damage. The wielder gains the same number of hit points (up to their normal maximum). This consumes one charge.

A flaming sword blade springs from the sphere, while the rod shortens to become the hilt. The sword casts light in a 30' radius and may be used to set things on fire (treat as a torch). Against fire-vulnerable foes, its attack bonuses increases: +2 vs bird-like creatures and creatures which cannot regenerate fire damage; +3 vs plant-creatures and undead.
An axe blade springs from the sphere, while the rod lengthens to become the handle.
A blade springs from the sphere, while the rod lengthens into a 6' long shaft.

The rod lengthens to up to 50' long, with horizontal climbing bars along both sides and spikes at either end. Attached to a solid surface at each end, the rod can support up to 40,000 coins of weight.
The wielder gains immediate knowledge of their elevation above/below ground and which direction is north.
Studs a, b, c, d, and e no longer function.

items.name: Rod of Parrying
items.description: A 5' metal rod which provides offensive and defensive capabilities in melee.

properties.value: The rod attacks as a +2 magic item, doing 1d8 damage.

Instead of attacking, the character may use the rod to parry, gaining a +4 bonus to AC versus melee attacks for one round. It is not possible to parry with the rod when retreating from melee (see Movement under Combat in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ).
Does not use charges; may be used an unlimited number of times.

items.name: Rod of Resurrection
items.description: Has the power to return the dead to life.

properties.value: Usable by divine spell casters only.

A deceased person within 120' is restored to life with full hit points. A person who has been dead for up to 100 years may be resurrected. The number of charges expended depends on the race of the person (see table below).
The rod can be used at most once per day.

items.name: Rod of Striking
items.description: A rod which can be used as a weapon and is especially potent against constructs and chaotic extra-planar monsters.

properties.value: The rod attacks as a +3 magic item, doing 1d8 damage.
(For example golems.) Each hit expends one charge and inflicts double damage. On a natural 20 attack roll, the construct is instantly destroyed.
On a natural 20 attack roll, one charge is expended and triple damage is inflicted.

items.name: Staff of Commanding
items.description: Grants the power to control animals, humans, and plants.

items.name: Staff of Dispelling
items.description: Dispels any magical effect which is touched.

properties.value: If the caster of the spell effect to be dispelled is higher than 9th level, there is a 5% chance per level difference that the attempt to dispel will fail.
One-use magic items (e.g. potions, scrolls) are destroyed utterly. Permanent items (e.g. armour, weapons, wands) are rendered non-magical for 1d4 rounds.

items.name: Staff of Healing
items.description: Has the power to heal those touched.

properties.value: Usable by divine spell casters only.
Heals 1d6+1 hit points with each usage.
Is effective on any individual at most once per day.
Does not use charges; may be used an unlimited number of times.

items.name: Staff of Power
items.description: An item of great wizardly power, this staff may be used as a weapon in melee, and may evoke five different magical effects.

properties.value: Usable by arcane spell casters only.
Expending one charge, inflicts 2d6 damage on a successful hit.
Conjures a cone of freezing energy, 60' long and 30' wide at the far end. Creatures caught in the cone suffer 8d6 damage ( save versus spells for half damage).
Can cast: continual light , fire ball (8d6 damage), lightning bolt (8d6 damage), telekinesis (up to 2,400 coins of weight). (See Magic-User Spells in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome .)

items.name: Staff of Snakes
items.description: A magical staff that has the power to transform into a snake, on command.

properties.value: Usable by divine spell casters only.
Treated as a staff with a +1 magic bonus to attacks and damage.
Upon a human-sized (or smaller) creature, the wielder of the staff may speak the command word, causing it to transform into a serpent and coil around the victim.
Must save versus spells or be immobilised in the coils of the snake. Victims are completely helpless while held by the snake (1d4 turns, or released as the wielder of the staff commands).
Has AC 5 [14], HD 3 (20hp), and a movement rate of 60' (20').
The snake returns to the owner and transforms back into a staff. (At this point, it is healed of any damage it has suffered.)
It does not return to its staff form, becoming non-magical.
Does not use charges; may be used any number of times.

items.name: Staff of Striking
items.description: Used as a magical melee weapon.

properties.value: Inflicts 2d6 damage on a successful hit.
Only one charge may be spent per strike.

items.name: Staff of Swarming Insects
items.description: Has the power to summon a swarm of biting insects.

properties.value: Usable by divine spell casters only.

A target within 60' + 10' per level of the wielder is covered with biting insects. The target cannot act for 1 round and suffers 6 damage + 1 per level of the wielder. The insect swarm then dissipates.
Creatures larger than human-sized or which have a natural AC better than 5 [14] are unaffected.

items.name: Staff of the Healer
items.description: Has the power to heal those touched.

properties.value: Usable by divine spell casters only.
Each usage has one of the following effects:
3d6+3 hit points.
b.  Cure disease
c.  Cure blindness
Each function can be used up to twice per day. A single subject can only be affected once per day.

items.name: Staff of Withering
items.description: Creatures hit by the staff are magically aged:

properties.value: Usable by divine spell casters only.
The target is aged 10 years. Living creatures die upon reaching their natural lifespan.
Ignore the effects of a certain amount of ageing. (For example, elves may ignore up to 200 years of ageing, dwarves ignore up to 50 years, and so on.)
Are unaffected by the power of this staff.

items.name: Staff of Wizardry
items.description: An item of supreme wizardly power, this staff may be used as a weapon in melee, and may evoke a dozen different magical effects.

properties.value: Usable by arcane spell casters only.
Treated as a staff with a +1 magic bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Expending one charge, inflicts 2d6 damage on a successful hit.
Conjures a cone of freezing energy, 60' long and 30' wide at the far end. Creatures caught in the cone suffer 8d6 damage, with a successful save versus spells indicating half damage.
Conjures a cone of magical energy, 60' long and 30' wide at the far end. Creatures caught in the cone are paralysed for 6 turns ( save versus spells to avoid).

Can cast: conjure elemental (8 HD), continual light , fire ball (8d6 damage), invisibility , lightning bolt (8d6 damage), pass-wall , telekinesis (up to 2,400 coins of weight), web . (See Magic-User Spells in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome .)

Conjures a whirlwind 70' tall, 20' wide at the top, and 10' wide at the base. The whirlwind lasts for 3 rounds, and moves at 120' (40'), as the wielder of the staff directs. All in its path suffer 2d6 damage. Creatures with less than 2HD are swept aside ( save versus death to avoid).

The wielder may sacrifice the staff by breaking it in two. Doing so unleashes a 30' radius fireball that inflicts 8 points of damage per remaining charge in the staff. The wielder of the staff also suffers this damage.

items.name: Staff of the Woodlands
items.description: An item of great druidic power, this staff may be used in melee and may evoke a number of different magical effects.

properties.value: Usable by divine spell casters with access to druidic magic only.
Acts as a +2 staff.
Causes a large tree within 30' to come alive under the control of the wielder of the staff.

Can cast: animal friendship , speak with animals , wall of thorns . (See the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome .) Animated tree: AC 2 [17], HD 8 (36hp), Att 2 × fist (2d6), THAC0 12 [+7], MV 30' (10'), SV D8 W9 P10 B10 S12 (8), ML 9, AL Lawful, XP 650

items.name: Wand of Cold
items.description: Conjures a cone of freezing energy.

properties.value: The cone is 60' long and 30' wide at the far end.
Suffer 6d6 damage, with a successful save versus wands indicating half damage.

items.name: Wand of Enemy Detection
items.description: Grants the power to detect nearby enemies.

properties.value: Causes enemies within 60' to be haloed in a fiery glow.
Even enemies that are concealed or invisible are affected.

items.name: Wand of Fear
items.description: Conjures a cone of magical energy that terrifies those within it.

properties.value: The cone is 60' long and 30' wide at the far end.
Are struck with terror, and will flee from the wielder of the wand at maximum speed for 30 rounds. (A save versus wands negates the effect).

items.name: Wand of Fire Balls
items.description: Conjures fire balls:

properties.value: A streak of flame shoots towards an area up to 240' distant.
The flame detonates in a 40' diameter sphere of fire.

properties.key: Creatures caught in the fire ball
properties.value: Suffer 6d6 damage, with a successful save versus wands indicating half damage.

items.name: Wand of Illusion
items.description: Expending a charge, an illusion of the character's choosing manifests. This works in the same way as the magic-user spell phantasmal force (see Magic-User Spells in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ), except:

properties.value: Is required to maintain the illusion. The wielder of the wand may move at up to half normal movement rate while concentrating. Concentration is broken if the wielder attacks, casts a spell, or is successfully attacked (damaged, targeted by a malicious spell, etc.).

items.name: Wand of Lightning Bolts
items.description: Conjures strokes of powerful electricity:

properties.value: A lightning bolt may emanate from a point up to 180' distant.
The bolt is 60' long and 5' wide.

properties.key: Creatures caught in the lightning bolt
properties.value: Suffer 6d6 damage, with a successful save versus wands indicating half damage.
If the lightning bolt hits a solid barrier before its full length is reached, it is reflected and travels for any remaining distance of its full length in the direction of the wielder of the wand.

items.name: Wand of Magic Detection
items.description: Grants the power to detect magic nearby.

properties.value: Causes magic items within 20' to be haloed with light.
Also glow, but the light might not be seen.

items.name: Wand of Magic Missiles
items.description: Shoots magic missiles which hit their mark unerringly.

properties.value: Each charge conjures a missile that unerringly hits a foe within 150' , inflicting 1d6+1 damage.
Up to 2 charges may be expended in a single round.

items.name: Wand of Metal Detection
items.description: Grants the power to detect masses of metal of any type.

properties.value: Causes the wand to point towards metal within 20' .
The type of metal is revealed.
Only masses of metal of at least 1,000 coins in weight are detected.

items.name: Wand of Negation
items.description: Has the power to negate the effects of other wands or staves.

properties.value: Before rolling initiative, the wielder of the wand must declare the intention to use it.
Another wand or staff must be targeted.
The effects of the targeted item are negated for one round.

items.name: Wand of Paralysation
items.description: Conjures a cone of paralysing energy.

properties.value: The cone is 60' long and 30' wide at the far end.
Are paralysed for 6 turns, with a successful save versus wands negating the effect.

items.name: Wand of Polymorph
items.description: By expending a charge, the wielder of the wand or another creature within 60' changes into another type of creature, as selected by the wielder. This works in the same way as the magic-user spells polymorph self and polymorph others (see Magic-User Spells in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ).

properties.value: An unwilling subject may make a saving throw versus wands to negate the effect.

items.name: Wand of Radiance
items.description: Has three different light-bringing effects.

properties.value: Expending one charge conjures light in a 15' radius, lasting for 6 turns. The light may be caused to emanate from a location or object within 120' .
Expending 2 charges conjures permanent light with a 30' radius. The light may be caused to emanate from a location or object within 120' .

Expending 3 charges conjures a momentary flash of blazing golden light rays, emanating from a point within 120' . Undead creatures within 40' of the flash suffer 6d6 damage. Creatures viewing the flash must save versus wands or be blinded for 1 round.

items.name: Wand of Secret Door Detection
items.description: Reveals the location of any secret door within 20' .

items.name: Wand of Summoning
items.description: Summons monsters to do the character's bidding.

properties.value: Expending a charge summons 2d4 1st level monsters.
Expending 2 charges summons 1d6 2nd level monsters.
Expending 3 charges summons 1d4 3rd level monsters.
The referee should randomly determine the type of monsters which are summoned, for example using dungeon wandering monster tables.
Summoned monsters arrive at the character's location in 1d4 rounds.
Monsters will attack enemies as directed or, if the character can communicate with them, be given other tasks.
The monsters disappear after 1 round per level of the character.

items.name: Wand of Trap Detection
items.description: Reveals the location of all traps within 20' .

items.name: Cursed Scroll
items.description: Usage: All characters (unless noted). Activation: Merely looking at the baneful script on the scroll curses the character. The referee should determine the nature of the curse (see examples below). Removing: A curse can be removed by magic, or (at the referee's option) by performing a special quest.

items.name: Protection Scroll
items.description: Usage: All characters (unless noted). (Written in non-magical languages-usually Common.) Activation: Reading the script aloud conjures a circle of protection against a specific type of monster or energy. Area of protection: When used, conjures a 10' radius circle of protection around the reader. Moving: If the reader moves, the circle of protection follows them.

items.name: Protection from Elementals
items.description: No elemental may enter the circle of protection.

properties.value: The circle does not prevent elementals from using magic or missile attacks against those within it.
If anyone within the circle attacks an affected elemental in melee, the circle is broken.
2 turns, unless broken.

items.name: Protection from Lycanthropes
items.description: A number of lycanthropes are barred from entering the circle of protection. The number depends on their Hit Dice: 1-3 HD: 1d10 lycanthropes affected, 4-5 HD: 1d8 affected, 6+ HD: 1d4 affected.

properties.value: The circle does not prevent lycanthropes from using magic or missile attacks against those within it.
If anyone within the circle attacks an affected lycanthrope in melee, the circle is broken.
6 turns, unless broken.

items.name: Protection from Magic
items.description: Spells and spell-like effects (e.g. from magic items) cannot cross the circle of protection. The barrier prevents magic from entering the circle, but also from leaving it.

properties.value: 1d4 turns.
Only by a wish.

items.name: Protection from Undead
items.description: A number of undead monsters are barred from entering the circle of protection. The number depends on their Hit Dice: 1-3 HD: 2d12 undead affected, 4-5 HD: 2d6 undead affected, 6+ HD: 1d6 undead affected.

properties.value: The circle does not prevent undead from using magic or missile attacks against those within it.
If anyone within the circle attacks an affected undead monster in melee, the circle is broken.
6 turns, unless broken.

items.name: Spell Scroll
items.description: Usage: Spell casters. Type of magic: 1-in-4 scrolls contain divine spells; the rest contain arcane spells. Activation: Reading the script aloud conjures the effect of a specific spell. Only arcane spell casters can use scrolls of arcane spells. Only divine spell casters can use scrolls of divine spells. Arcane spell scrolls: Are written in magical script that can only be read by magic. Divine spell scrolls: Are written in normal languages (usually Common), but can only be used by divine spell casters. Scrolls of multiple spells: If a scroll contains multiple spells, only the spell cast disappears from the scroll.

items.name: Spells on a Scroll
items.description: The referee may choose the spells or may roll for them randomly. The table below may be used to select the level of each spell on a scroll.

items.name: Treasure Map
items.description: Usage: All characters (unless noted). A map that indicates the route to a valuable treasure, located in a dungeon or wilderness. Interpreting: Treasure maps may not always be easy to interpret: a map may be incomplete, worded in riddles, or written in an obscure language. Preparing in advance: The referee should prepare treasure maps in advance.

items.name: Treasures
items.description: The following list of treasure map types may be used to determine the nature of the treasure that a map leads to.

properties.value: 1 magic item.
1d6 × 10 gems and 2d10 pieces of jewellery.
2 magic items.
3 magic items (no swords).
3 magic items and 1 potion.
3 magic items, 1 scroll, 1 potion.
5d6 gems and 2 magic items.
Hoard worth 1d4 × 1,000gp.
Hoard worth 5d6 × 1,000gp.
Hoard worth 5d6 × 1,000gp and 1 magic item.
Hoard worth 5d6 × 1,000gp and 5d6 gems.
Hoard worth 6d6 × 1,000gp.

items.name: Hoard Value
items.description: For treasure hoards with a listed gold piece value, the referee may choose what type of treasure is in the hoard. (For example, it may be coins, but could also consist of valuable art objects or jewels.)

items.name: Short Sword +2, Quickness
items.description: Enables the bearer to strike with great speed.

properties.value: When attacking with the sword, the wielder always strikes first in the round, as if they had won initiative.

items.name: Sword -1, Berserker (Cursed)
items.description: When used in battle, causes the wielder to go into a berserk rage.

properties.value: The wielder attacks the closest creature, whether it is friend or foe. If the creature is killed, the wielder attacks the next nearest.
Only if the wielder dies or slays all within 60' .

items.name: Sword +1, Dragon Slayer
items.description: Deadly to dragons, especially those of a specific type.

properties.value: Chosen randomly (e.g. red dragons, white dragons, etc.).
Acts as a +3 sword and inflicts double damage.
Acts as a +3 sword.

items.name: Sword +1, Energy Drain
items.description: Drains the life energy of its victims.

properties.value: The wielder may command the sword to drain the victim's life energy.

In addition to suffering normal damage, the target permanently loses one experience level (or Hit Die). This incurs a loss of one Hit Die of hit points, as well as all other benefits due to the drained level (e.g. spells, saving throws, etc.). A character's XP is reduced to the lowest amount for the new level. A person drained of all levels dies.
The sword may drain a total of 1d4+4 levels. Once this many levels have been drained, it becomes a normal magical sword +1.

items.name: Sword +1, Flaming
items.description: Bursts into flames, on command. When flaming:

properties.value: In 30' radius.
Treated as a torch, for purposes of setting things on fire (e.g. a web spell).
Which may have special effects on certain creatures.
Against certain types of creatures:
a. +2 vs trolls (or other creatures that cannot regenerate fire damage).
b. +2 vs pegasi, hippogriffs, and rocs (or other bird-like creatures).
c. +3 vs treants (or other plant-based creatures).
d. +3 vs undead.
The sword blazes until commanded to cease.

items.name: Sword +1, Frost Brand
items.description: Grants special benefits against fire and creatures with an affinity for fire.

properties.value: 30' radius.
+3 against fire-using or fire-dwelling creatures.
50% chance of extinguishing a 10' radius area when thrust into fire. This also affects magical fire (but not instantaneous effects).
The wielder gains the following benefits:
Unharmed by non-magical fire.
Gain a +2 bonus to all saving throws versus fire-based magical or breath attacks.
Is reduced by 1 point per damage die rolled. (Each die inflicts a minimum of 1 hit point damage.)

items.name: Sword +1, Giant Slayer
items.description: Deadly to giants and giant-kin (e.g. ogres, ettins, etc.).

properties.value: Acts as a +3 sword.
Acts as a +3 sword and inflicts double damage.

items.name: Sword +1, Light
items.description: On command, produces light in a 30' radius.

items.name: Sword +1, Locate Objects
items.description: Grants the wielder the ability to detect the presence of objects within 120' .

properties.value: This works in the same way as the magic-user spell locate object (see Magic-User Spells in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ).
The power may be used once per day.

items.name: Sword +1, Luck Blade
items.description: Grants the wielder protection and a number of wishes (see Wishes, p149 ).

properties.value: +1 bonus to all saves.
The sword grants a total of 1d4 wishes.
The wish must be spoken out loud by the wielder of the sword.

items.name: Sword +1, Sharpness
items.description: An incredibly sharp blade which can sever extremities.

properties.value: On a natural 18, 19, or 20 attack roll, one of the target's extremities is severed. Against larger than human-sized targets, only a natural 19 or 20 severs, and against targets of solid stone or metal, only a natural 20.
Determined randomly, depending on the target (e.g. arm, leg, tail, tentacle, neck, etc.).

items.name: Sword +1, Sun Blade
items.description: A sword of pristine, shining silver with an enchantment effective against the powers of darkness.

properties.value: Acts as a +3 sword against incorporeal creatures of shadow (e.g. spectres, shadows).
Once per day, the wielder may whirl the blade above their head. This conjures a 60' radius globe of golden light which lasts for 1 turn.
Are affected by the globe of light as if it were full daylight.

items.name: Sword +1, Wishes
items.description: Has the power to grant the wielder's wishes (see Wishes, p149 ).

properties.value: The sword grants a total of 1d4 wishes.
The wish must be spoken out loud by the wielder of the sword.

items.name: Sword +1, Wounding
items.description: Inflicts vicious, bleeding wounds.

properties.value: After being hit, the target suffers 1 additional point of damage per round (up to a maximum of 10 rounds).
Each deal additional damage per round.
Bandaging a wound stops it bleeding and negates further damage.
Damage from the sword cannot be healed by magic or regeneration.
Constructs and creatures without blood are unaffected by the sword's wounding effect.

items.name: Sword +2, Charm Person
items.description: Grants the wielder the ability to charm other people.

properties.value: This works in the same way as the magic-user spell charm person (see the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ).
The power may be used up to three times a week.

items.name: Sword +2, Dancing
items.description: A sword with the power to attack of its own accord, dancing out of its owner's hand.

properties.value: Before the sword may be released to attack independently (called 'dancing'), the wielder must attack with it for 4 consecutive rounds.
The sword attacks for 4 rounds, using the owner's THAC0. After 4 rounds it returns to its owner's hand.
The sword can dance within 30' of its owner. If the two are separated more than 30' , the sword ceases to dance, falling to the ground.

items.name: Sword +2, Nine Lives Stealer
items.description: Has the power to suck the soul out of living creatures.

properties.value: On a natural 20 attack roll, the target must save versus spells or have their soul sucked out (instant death). If the save succeeds, the sword inflicts normal damage.
The sword can steal nine souls in total. Once this many souls have been drained, it becomes a normal magical sword +2.
Non-living creatures are unaffected.

items.name: Sword +2, Venger
items.description: Magically attacks any opponent that attacked the wielder.

properties.value: When wielding this sword in combat, the character always attacks last in the round, as if they had lost initiative.

In addition to the character's normal attack, they may make an extra attack with the sword against any opponent who attacked them in melee this round. Each revenge attack requires an attack roll and, if it hits, inflicts normal damage.

items.name: Sword +2, Vorpal
items.description: An incredibly sharp blade which can decapitate enemies.

properties.value: On an attack roll of natural 18, 19, or 20, the target is decapitated. Against larger than human-sized targets, only a natural 19 or 20 decapitates, and against targets of solid stone or metal, only a natural 20.
Creatures without a head are unaffected. Some creatures with heads (e.g. constructs, elementals) are not killed by decapitation.

items.name: Sword +3, Defender
items.description: Can grant a bonus to attack or to defence, determined by the wielder each round.

properties.value: At the start of each combat round, the wielder may choose to transfer all or part of the sword's +3 bonus to an AC bonus against melee attacks. The bonus lasts until the end of the round.

items.name: Sword +3, Holy Avenger
items.description: A holy sword which grants special bonuses to lawful characters of classes which can cast clerical spells.

properties.value: The wielder gains a +4 bonus to saves against magic.
Inflicts double damage.
The sword functions as a +1 sword, without the other advantages described above.
The sword inflicts 1d6 damage per round to neutral characters and 2d6 per round to chaotic characters.

items.name: Arrow +1, Slaying
items.description: An arrow specially enchanted to kill a certain type of foe. The arrow has an unusual appearance that indicates its special nature and purpose.

properties.value: Should be selected by the referee. (e.g. birds, spiders, dragons, magic-users, mammals, undead, etc.).
Acts as a +3 arrow. If the attack hits, the foe is instantly slain.

items.name: Crossbow +1, Distance
items.description: An enchanted crossbow which can fire up to double the normal range.

items.name: Crossbow +1, Speed
items.description: An enchanted crossbow which can fire with great rapidity.

properties.key: If using the optional reload rule
properties.value: (See Weapons and Armour in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome .) The crossbow can be reloaded so rapidly that it may fire every round in combat.
The crossbow always attacks first in the round, as if the wielder had won initiative.

items.name: Crossbow +2, Accuracy
items.description: An enchanted crossbow which can fire with precision, even at long range.

properties.value: The normal -1 range modifier does not apply.
Is not increased by the enchantment.

items.name: Dagger +1, Buckle
items.description: An ornamental belt buckle which can transform into a magical dagger.

properties.value: The owner must simply grasp the buckle and will it to become a dagger.
After use, the blade may be returned to its buckle form by touching it to the belt and willing it to transform.

items.name: Dagger +1, Throwing
items.description: A finely balanced dagger ideal for use as a missile weapon.

properties.value: The dagger has double the normal throwing range: 5'-20' / 21'-40' / 41'-60' .
When used as a missile weapon, the dagger inflicts double damage on a successful hit.

items.name: Dagger +1, Venomous
items.description: A dagger that magically injects venom into the victim when it strikes true.

properties.value: If the wielder rolls an attack roll of natural 20, the dagger injects venom into the victim ( save versus death or die instantly).

items.name: Dagger +2, Biter
items.description: A broad-bladed dagger which has special properties in the hands of a demihuman of smaller than human size.

properties.value: The blade lengthens to that of a short sword, inflicting 1d6+2 damage.
On a successful hit against a foe composed of wood or stone, the blade inflicts maximum damage.

items.name: Javelin of Lightning
items.description: A magical javelin which explodes in a stroke of lightning when it hits.

properties.value: The javelin explodes in a stroke of lightning 5' wide and 30' long (leading from the target 30' back towards the character who hurled the javelin). All within the area (including the target who was hit) suffer electrical damage.
20 points ( save versus spells for half). The target hit by the javelin may not make a saving throw.
When it explodes into lightning, the javelin is destroyed.

items.name: Javelin of Seeking
items.description: A magical javelin which can launch itself at a target on command.

properties.value: Speaking the correct command word causes the javelin to fly out of the character's hands to seek the indicated target (up to 90' distant).
The javelin can fly in any direction to reach its target, including around obstacles or corners. The character must make an attack roll with a +6 bonus to determine if the javelin hits.
The javelin inflicts 1d4+6 damage.
The javelin may only be commanded to launch itself once. Afterwards, it is a normal, non-magical javelin.

items.name: Mace +1, Disrupting
items.description: A mace enchanted as a powerful bane against undead monsters.

properties.value: The mace inflicts 5d4 damage.
On a successful hit, the mace inflicts double damage and has a chance of destroying the monster ( save versus death or be instantly annihilated).

items.name: Sling Bullet +1, Impact
items.description: A cast metal sling bullet which inflicts additional damage on an accurate hit.

properties.value: The bullet is engraved with fine runes.

If the attack roll was higher than the minimum roll required to hit the target, the bullet inflicts additional damage. The additional damage is equal to the actual attack roll minus the minimum required to hit the target. For example, if an attack roll of 12 or more is required to hit a target and a 16 is rolled, the bullet inflicts 4 additional points of damage to the target.

items.name: Spear -1, Backbiter (Cursed)
items.description: A cursed spear which attacks its wielder.

properties.value: On an attack roll of natural 1, the spear inflicts damage on its wielder.

items.name: Staff +1, Growing
items.description: A staff of sturdy wood, banded with iron at each tip. The staff has the power to grow and shrink on command.

properties.value: The staff can be any length between 6' and 12'
The wielder can attack foes at up to the staff 's length distant.

items.name: Trident -2, Yearning (Cursed)
items.description: A cursed trident which causes one who touches it to be overcome with a yearning to immerse themselves in deep water.

properties.value: The wielder is instantly compelled to seek out the nearest body of water sufficient to fully submerge themselves in.
The trident does not grant any special ability to breathe underwater.

items.name: Trident +1, Fish Command
items.description: A trident enchanted with the power to empathically control fish.

properties.value: Speaking a command word causes all fish within 60' to save versus spells or be charmed. This consumes one charge.

The fish obeys empathic commands from the wielder, who can control its movement and behavioural state (e.g. anger, fear, hunger, etc.). The charm lasts as long as the fish can see the trident and the one who wields it.
The fish is not charmed, but will not approach closer than 10' to the wielder of the trident.
May be treated as a single entity, rather than making a save for each individual fish.

items.name: Trident +1, Submission
items.description: A trident enchanted with the power to demoralise foes.

properties.value: The target must save versus spells or be demoralised. This consumes one charge.
Must make a morale check or surrender. The demoralisation lasts for 2d4 rounds.

items.name: Tridents
items.description: Tridents are treated as spears, for combat purposes (1d6 damage). They cannot be thrown.

items.name: Trident +2, Warning
items.description: An enchanted trident which can warn the wielder of marine predators.

properties.value: On command, the trident can detect all hostile marine predators within 240' (including those which are hunting). The scan takes one round and consumes one charge.

items.name: War Hammer +3, Dwarven Thrower
items.description: In the hands of a dwarf, this weapon may function as a thrown missile weapon.

properties.value: It returns to its wielder's hands.

items.name: War Hammer +3, Thunderbolts
items.description: A war hammer of unusually large size and weight. In the hands of a very strong character, it has several magical powers.

properties.value: Only characters of 17 STR or higher can wield the hammer.
The hammer may be hurled as a missile weapon, with a range of 60' .
A great clap of thunder rings out, stunning all within 30' ( save versus paralysis or be unable to move or act for 3 rounds).
The hammer returns to the wielder's hands.
The hammer may be hurled at most 3 times in the space of 1 turn (i.e. 3 times per combat). 232 C 233

items.name: Using a Sentient Sword
items.description: Sentient swords grant the wielder special powers beyond those of a normal magic sword, but using one also carries risks.

properties.value: To use a power, the sword must be in the wielder's hand.
The wielder must concentrate to activate a power.

items.name: Control
items.description: A sentient sword has its own personality and can, at times, attempt to exercise control over the person who wields it. A control check (see below) is triggered in any of the following circumstances:

properties.value: Upon the character first touching the sword.
When the character is reduced to half hit points or less.
When another magic weapon comes into the character's possession.
Upon every use, if the sword and the character are of different alignments.
If the sword has a special purpose: every time the special purpose is applicable. (e.g. when encountering a character or creature of the type the sword is designed to slay.)

items.name: Control Checks
items.description: When one of the aforementioned circumstances occurs, a control check is required: 1. Determine the sword's Will score:

properties.value: a. The sum of its INT and Ego.
b. Add one for each extraordinary power the sword has.
c. Add 1d10 if the sword and the wielder of are different alignments. 2. Determine the wielder's Will score:
a. The sum of STR and WIS scores.

b. If the character has less than full hit points, Will is reduced by 1d4 (or 2d4 if the character has less than half hit points). 3. Compare the Will scores. If the sword's Will score is higher, it takes control of the character's actions.

items.name: When the Sword Takes Control
items.description: The referee determines the behaviour of the character, via the sword, for example:

properties.value: Discarding other weapons, or ignoring newly discovered magic weapons.
Charging into battle, in order to gain glory for the sword.
To a foe whom the sword deems either more worthy of possessing it or more susceptible to being controlled.

Making lavish expenditures for the sword. Purchasing expensive sheaths, having jewels fitted, having enchantments and wards applied, etc. The sword may force the character to spend most of their money on such things!

items.name: Ending Control
items.description: Once in control, the sword will only release the character when the circumstance that triggered the control check is over or when the sword is otherwise satisfied.

items.name: Extraordinary Powers
items.description: Each power should be rolled on the table below. Duplicates should be re-rolled, unless noted. Usage frequency: Unless a power's description notes otherwise, it may be used at most three times a day.

items.name: Clairaudience
items.description: Enables the wielder to hear through the ears of another creature.

properties.value: The wielder must concentrate for one turn to activate this power.
The other creature must be within 60' .
Lead blocks this power.

items.name: Clairvoyance
items.description: Enables the wielder to see through the eyes of another creature.

properties.value: The wielder must concentrate for one turn to activate this power.
The other creature must be within 60' .
Lead blocks this power.

items.name: ESP
items.description: Enables the wielder to read the thoughts of another living creature.

properties.value: The wielder must concentrate in a specific direction to activate this power.
The other creature must be within 60' .
The wielder gains an empathic understanding of the creature's thoughts.
Lead blocks this power.

items.name: Extra Damage
items.description: Increases the wielder's strength for 1d10 rounds. While the power is active, damage inflicted by the wielder is multiplied by 4.

items.name: Duplicates
items.description: If this power is rolled more than once, the damage multiplier is increased by one for each duplicate roll.

items.name: Flying
items.description: The wielder is able to fly for up to 3 turns.

properties.value: A speed of up to 360' (120') is possible.
Is possible in any direction, including the ability to levitate and to hover in mid-air.

items.name: Healing
items.description: The sword heals damage.

properties.value: One point of damage is healed per round, for six rounds.
This power may only be activated once a day.

items.name: Duplicates
items.description: If this power is rolled more than once, the duration of the power is increased by 6 rounds for each duplicate.

items.name: Illusion
items.description: An illusion of the wielder's choosing manifests. This works in the same way as the magic-user spell phantasmal force (see Magic-User Spells in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ).

items.name: Levitation
items.description: Grants the wielder the ability to move up and down through the air for up to 3 turns:

properties.value: The wielder mentally directs vertical movement at up to 20' per round.
The character can push against solid objects to move laterally. Weight: A normal amount of weight can be carried while levitating.

items.name: Telekinesis
items.description: By concentrating, the wielder is able to move objects or creatures within 120' by the power of thought.

properties.value: Up to 2,000 coins of weight may be targeted.
The target may be moved up to 20' per round, in whatever direction the wielder wishes (including vertically).
A targeted creature may save versus spells to resist.
Up to 6 rounds.
If concentration is broken, the target falls.

items.name: Telepathy
items.description: Enables the wielder to read the thoughts of another living creature.

properties.value: The wielder must concentrate in a specific direction to activate this power.
The other creature must be within 60' .
The wielder gains an empathic understanding of the creature's thoughts.
The wielder may also initiate a bidirectional telepathic communication with the creature, though it is not compelled to respond.
Lead blocks this power.

items.name: Teleportation
items.description: The wielder is able to teleport, per the magic-user spell (see Magic-User Spells in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ).

items.name: X-Ray Vision
items.description: Allows the wielder to see through solid objects.

properties.value: Sight up to 30' through stone is possible.
Sight up to 60' through less dense materials (cloth, water, wood) is possible. Obstructions: Sight through gold or lead is blocked.

When used for the purpose of searching (see Dungeon Adventuring in the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome ), the wielder is guaranteed to notice secret doors or traps in the 10' square area being examined.
Usage requires concentration (the wielder cannot move).
This power may not be activated more frequently than once per turn.

items.name: Sensory Powers
items.description: Each sensory power should be rolled on the table below, with duplicates re-rolled. Usage frequency: Unless a power's description notes otherwise, it may be used without limit.

items.name: Detect Evil or Good
items.description: The wielder can sense the intention to do evil or good within 20' . (Note: some potentially harmful things-e.g. animals, traps-are not evil.)

items.name: Detect Gems
items.description: The sword will point in the direction of any gems within 60' .

properties.value: The wielder is also informed of the number of gems present.
Lead blocks this power.

items.name: Detect Magic
items.description: Up to three times a day, the sword can detect magic within 20' . On command, the magic may be caused to glow.

items.name: Detect Metals
items.description: The sword will point in the direction of metal of a named type within 60' .

properties.value: Lead blocks this power.

items.name: Detect Shifting Architecture
items.description: The wielder can locate shifting walls or rooms up to 10' distant.

items.name: Detect Slopes
items.description: The wielder can sense sloped floors within 10' .

items.name: Detect Traps
items.description: Up to three times a day, the wielder can sense traps within 10' .

items.name: Locate Secret Doors
items.description: Up to three times a day, the wielder can find all secret doors within 10' .

items.name: See Invisible Objects
items.description: The wielder can see invisible or concealed objects up to 20' distant. (This power does not reveal secret doors.)

items.name: d6 Type of Target to be Slain

properties.value: 1 Arcane spell casters
2 Divine spell casters
3 Warriors (e.g. fighters or other primarily combat-oriented, nonspell casting classes, including non-spell casting demihumans)
4 Specific type of monster (determine randomly)
5 Lawful creatures (or chaotic creatures if the sword is lawful)
6 Chaotic creatures (or lawful creatures if the sword is chaotic)

items.name: Alignment Power
items.description: In addition to their sensory and extraordinary powers, swords of special purpose have an extra power when used to achieve their designated purpose (e.g. when attacking the enemy the sword was designed to slay). This power depends on the sword's alignment:

properties.value: Chaotic foes hit by the sword must save versus spells or be paralysed.
The wielder gains a +1 bonus to all saving throws.
Lawful foes hit by the sword must save versus spells or be turned to stone. 18 8 O ? 8 241

items.name: Referee's Tome
items.description: The essential old-school game of fantastic adventure, monsters,  and  magic  -  expanded  with  advanced monsters and treasures!

properties.value: This book contains full guidelines for creating and running adventures, over 300 fearsome monsters, and over 300 wondrous magic items.
Simple rules let imagination and fast-paced action take the spotlight.
Clear, modern presentation makes the game easy to learn and quick to reference.

Compatible with decades of classic adventures and supplements. Includes all monsters and magic items from the Classic Fantasy game plus loads more! Requires the companion book, the Advanced Fantasy Player's Tome .

items.name: Ability Checks: Roll 1d20
items.description: Result: Lower or equal = success. Difficulty: -4 (easy) to +4 (very difficult). 1s and 20s: 1s always pass, 20s always fail. Falling Falling from a height onto a hard surface inflicts 1d6 damage per 10' fallen.

items.name: Healing
items.description: Natural: 1d3hp per day of complete rest Magical: Takes effect instantaneously. May be combined with natural healing.

items.name: Hiring Retainers: Roll 2d6
items.description: CHA modifier: Of hiring PC applies. Generosity: -2 to +2, based on offer. Bad reputation: -1 or -2.

items.name: Saving Throws: Roll 1d20
items.description: Result: Higher or equal = save succeeds.

items.name: Sequence Per Dungeon Turn (10m)
items.description: 1.  Wandering monsters 2.  Party decides course of actions 3.  Description: The referee describes what happens. 4.  End of turn: Update time records, checking light sources, spell durations, rest.

items.name: Wandering Monsters
items.description: Chance: Typically 1-in-6 every 2 turns.

items.name: Doors
items.description: Listening: Base 1-in-6 chance of success. Shutting: Doors may close after PCs pass. Stuck: Chance of forcing depends on STR. Failed attempt alerts monsters.

items.name: Movement
items.description: Exploring the unknown: Characters move their movement rate per turn. In familiar areas: Referee may allow a faster movement rate.

items.name: Resting
items.description: Frequency of rest: One turn every hour. Penalty: -1 to hit and damage rolls.

items.name: Searching: 1-in-6 Chance
items.description: Area: Particular 10' × 10' area. Time: Searching takes one turn.

items.name: Traps
items.description: Chance of triggering: 2-in-6 chance when PC makes action that could trigger. Types: Room trap, treasure trap. PCs can find room traps by searching.

items.name: Sequence Per Wilderness Day
items.description: 1.  Party decides course of travel 2.  Losing direction 3.  Weather: When waterborne. 4.  Wandering monsters 5.  Description: The referee describes the regions passed through and any sites of interest, asking players for their actions as required. 6.  End of day: Update time records, checking rations, spell durations, rest.

items.name: Losing Direction: Roll 1d6
items.description: Clear, grasslands: 1-in-6. Barren, hills, mountains, woods: 2-in-6. Desert, jungle, swamp: 3-in-6.

items.name: Wandering Monsters
items.description: Frequency: Typically rolled once per day. City, clear, grasslands, settled: 1-in-6. Air, barren, desert, forest, hills: 2-in-6. Jungle, mountains, swamp: 3-in-6.

items.name: Finding Food
items.description: Foraging: Performed alongside travel. 1-in-6 chance of food for 1d6 humans. Hunting: Sole activity of day. 1-in-6 chance of encountering animals.

items.name: Movement
items.description: Miles/day: Base movement rate ÷ 5. Broken, desert, forest, hills: 33% slower. Jungle, mountains, swamp: 50% slower. Maintained roads: 50% faster. Forced march: 50% faster, rest 1 day after.

items.name: Resting
items.description: Frequency of rest: One day out of seven. Penalty: -1 to hit and damage rolls.

items.name: Encounter Sequence
items.description: 1.  Surprise 2.  Determine encounter distance 3.  Initiative: Unsurprised sides only. 4.  Actions: Any sides that are not surprised decide how they will respond to the encounter. The encounter is played out accordingly. 5.  Conclusion: One turn has passed.

items.name: Surprise: Each Side Rolls 1d6
items.description: Result: 1 or 2 = surprised.

items.name: Encounter Distance
items.description: Dungeon: 2d6 × 10 feet. Wilderness or waterborne: 4d6 × 10 yards (1d4 × 10 yards with surprise).

items.name: Initiative: Each Side Rolls 1d6
items.description: Result: Highest acts first. Ties: Either roll again or resolve actions on both sides simultaneously. Slow weapons: Always act last in round.

items.name: Monster Reactions: Roll 2d6
items.description: CHA modifier: Of interacting PC applies.

items.name: Sequence Per Combat Round (10s)
items.description: 1.  Declare spells and melee movement 2.  Initiative: Each side rolls 1d6. 3.  Winning side acts:

properties.value: a.  Monster morale
b.  Movement
c.  Missile attacks
d.  Spell casting
e.  Melee attacks 4.  Other sides act: In initiative order.

items.name: Morale: Roll 2d6
items.description: Result: Higher than morale score: monster surrenders or flees. When to check: First death on side; side half incapacitated. Morale scores of 2 or 12: Never check morale. Score of 2: Never fights. Score of 12: Fights to the death.

items.name: Movement in Melee
items.description: Fighting withdrawal: Move backwards at up to half encounter movement rate. Retreat: Flee at full encounter movement rate. Cannot attack, opponent gains +2 bonus to hit, ignoring shield bonus to AC.

items.name: Missile Attacks (>5' Away)
items.description: Range: Short: +1 to hit; Long: -1 to hit. Partial cover: -1 to -4 to hit.

items.name: Spell Casting
items.description: Sole action: No move or other action. If caster is hit or fails a save, Disrupting: the spell being cast is lost.

items.name: Attacking: Roll 1d20
items.description: Modifiers: Melee: STR modifies attack and damage. Missile: DEX modifies attack. 1s and 20s: 1s always miss, 20s always hit.

items.name: Damage
items.description: PCs: 1d6 (optional rule: by weapon). Melee: STR modifies damage. Monsters: Indicated in description. Minimum damage: At least 1. Death: At 0 hit points or less.

items.name: Common Combat Situations
items.description: Attacks from behind: Ignore shield AC. Blind characters: Cannot attack. Paralysed characters: Can be automati- cally hit (just roll damage). Unarmed attacks: 1d2 damage, modified by STR.
